paper.title: REAL-Q: E2E LLM Quantization via Dynamic Gradient Descent
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) under strict resource constraints. State-of-the-art PTQ methods quantize each layer with a single closed-form second-order solver: to remain analytically tractable, they heavily approximate the global loss (dropping cross-channel coupling, pooling output rows into groups), and they then freeze the resulting Hessian across the entire layer, with no way to refresh it as the loss landscape shifts column by colu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 LLM 后训练量化里一个很具体但长期存在的问题：主流 GPTQ 系方法为了保留列级闭式求解，会把真实的端到端量化损失近似得过于粗糙，既忽略上游已量化层带来的输入扰动，也忽略下游任务损失对不同输出通道的非均匀敏感性；同时 Hessian 在整层内被冻结，随着列逐步量化，优化目标已经变了，求解器却还在用旧信息。作者把这个问题概括为 information misalignment。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的意义主要在部署与训练接口上。量化本身属于推理效率，但这篇工作有两点值得预训练研究员关注。第一，它把“层内局部重建误差最小”与“端到端 KL 最小”之间的错位讲得很清楚，这种目标错位分析对蒸馏、剪枝、低秩适配甚至训练期近似优化都有参考价值。第二，它说明在大模型压缩里，静态二阶近似未必比动态一阶更新更合适；当目标随量化过程持续漂移时，在线刷新梯度信息比一次性求 Hessian 更重要。这个判断不只适用于 PTQ，也和很多 sequential optimization 问题相通。
summary.technical_approach:
REAL-Q 的方法可以概括成“换目标 + 换求解方式”。

先说目标。作者不再用 GPTQ 那种 layer-local reconstruction MSE，而是构造了一个 end-to-end-aligned surrogate：Aggregated Fisher MSE。它来自对全局输出 KL divergence 在当前 block 输出处做二阶 Taylor 展开。与很多近似方法不同，这里保留了完整 aggregated Fisher matrix，因此不再把输出通道之间的耦合简单丢掉。为了控制计算量，展开点选在 block 输出，使反向传播只需覆盖至多相邻两个 block，而不是整网回传。另一个细节是 loss sliding window：在顺序量化相邻 transformer block 时，目标函数如果突然从一个 block 切到下一个 block，优化景观会不连续，作者用滑动窗口平滑这个过渡，减少 block boundary 处的抖动。

再说求解。作者认为 GPTQ lineage 的根本限制在于必须维持列级闭式解，所以只能接受被压缩过的 Hessian，并且整层内固定不变。REAL-Q 改成 Dynamic Block-wise Gradient Descent：仍沿用列式顺序量化框架，但每量化完一个 column block（128 列）就插入一次 Adam 更新。这个更新直接对当前“部分已量化”的真实状态重新计算梯度，因此能在线修正上游误差累积，也能跟随损失景观变化。作者强调这是把修正粒度从 per-layer 提升到 per-column-block，细了大约两个数量级。Adam 的对角预条件器在这里起到隐式二阶信息的作用，但不需要显式求逆 Hessian。

从方法定位看，REAL-Q 不是完全抛弃 GPTQ 的 sequential pipeline，而是在其框架内引入更贴近端到端目标的损失和更高频的动态修正。这一点很实际，因为它兼顾了现有推理栈的兼容性与性能改进。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 LLaMA-3.1 8B、70B，以及 Qwen3 0.6B 到 32B 多个规模，主要看 W4A16 设定下的 KL divergence，并与 GPTQ 及其后续改进方法比较。作者给出的 headline 结果是：REAL-Q 在所有评测模型上都取得最低 KL，在 Qwen3-1.7B 的 W4A16 上，KL 最多可下降约 49%。这个结果支持两件事：一是端到端对齐目标比层局部 MSE 更有效；二是在线动态更新确实能缓解 sequential quantization 中的信息失配。

从论文叙述看，消融重点应包括三部分：Aggregated Fisher MSE 相对普通重建损失的收益、loss sliding window 对跨 block 稳定性的作用、以及 Block-GD 的更新频率与是否使用 Adam 的影响。虽然给到的全文片段没有列出完整表格数字，但方法设计已经暗示作者会比较“只换目标不换求解”“只做动态更新不用 Fisher loss”“不同 block size”这几类设置。阅读时应特别看这些消融，因为它们决定性能提升究竟来自更好的 loss，还是来自更频繁的 online correction。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction，把作者对 GPTQ 系方法三类近似的批评读清楚：未校正上游输入扰动、未建模下游通道敏感性、层内 Hessian 静态冻结。然后直接看方法部分里 Aggregated Fisher MSE 的推导和 Block-GD 的算法框图，理解为什么反传只需局部 block，以及为什么每 128 列更新一次是一个折中。

结果部分优先看主表和消融表。主表回答“是否稳定赢”；消融回答“赢在哪里”。如果只打算花 25–35 分钟，读完引言、方法总览、主结果和关键消融就够了。若要深挖，建议看附录里的复杂度分析、校准数据设置、以及不同模型规模下收益是否一致。另一个值得留意的点是：KL 改善能否稳定转化成下游困惑度或生成质量改善，这决定它在真实部署中的含义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in post-training quantization for LLMs. GPTQ-style methods keep the optimization analytically solvable at the column level, but they do so by over-simplifying the true end-to-end objective. They ignore perturbed inputs coming from already quantized upstream layers, treat output-channel errors too uniformly relative to the downstream loss, and freeze second-order information across an entire layer even though the loss landscape changes as columns are quantized one by one. The authors call this mismatch information misalignment.
summary_en.importance: The direct domain is inference efficiency, but the paper is still relevant to foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, it gives a clean analysis of objective mismatch: minimizing layer-local reconstruction error is not the same as minimizing end-to-end KL. That framing is useful beyond quantization, including distillation, pruning, low-rank adaptation, and other approximate optimization settings. Second, it argues that a dynamic first-order correction can be better than a static second-order approximation when the target keeps drifting during a sequential procedure. That lesson generalizes to many optimization problems around large models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
REAL-Q changes both the objective and the solver.

On the objective side, it replaces the standard layer-local reconstruction MSE with an end-to-end-aligned surrogate called Aggregated Fisher MSE. This surrogate is derived from a second-order Taylor expansion of the global KL divergence at the current transformer block output. Unlike grouped approximations that discard cross-channel interactions, REAL-Q keeps the full aggregated Fisher matrix, so output-channel coupling is preserved. To keep the computation manageable, the expansion point is chosen so that backpropagation only needs to traverse at most two adjacent blocks rather than the full network. The method also introduces a loss sliding window to smooth transitions across neighboring blocks, reducing discontinuities in the optimization landscape during sequential block-wise quantization.

On the optimization side, the paper argues that the core limitation of the GPTQ lineage is its dependence on a closed-form column-wise solver. That requirement forces heavy Hessian compression and then freezes the approximation for the whole layer. REAL-Q instead uses Dynamic Block-wise Gradient Descent. It still follows a sequential column-wise quantization pipeline, but after each column block of 128 columns it inserts one Adam update. The gradient is recomputed online against the actual partially quantized model state, so the method can correct accumulated upstream errors and adapt to the shifted loss landscape as quantization progresses. The authors describe this as increasing the correction granularity from per-layer to per-column-block, roughly two orders of magnitude finer. Adam’s diagonal preconditioning provides an implicit second-order effect without explicit Hessian inversion.

Importantly, REAL-Q is not a complete departure from GPTQ-style pipelines. It is a practical modification that keeps the sequential structure while making both the loss and the correction mechanism more faithful to the end-to-end objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover LLaMA-3.1 8B and 70B, and Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B. The main metric is KL divergence under weight-only W4A16 quantization, compared against GPTQ and more recent variants. The headline result is that REAL-Q achieves the lowest KL on every evaluated model, with up to about 49% KL reduction on Qwen3-1.7B at W4A16.

That result supports two claims: the end-to-end-aligned Fisher-based objective is better than plain layer-local reconstruction loss, and dynamic online updates help mitigate the error accumulation that appears in sequential quantization.

The most important ablations are likely the contribution of Aggregated Fisher MSE over standard reconstruction losses, the effect of the loss sliding window on stability across block boundaries, and the role of Block-GD frequency and optimizer choice. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, but those ablations are where the paper’s argument really stands or falls. In particular, the key question is whether the gain mainly comes from a better loss, from more frequent online correction, or from the combination of both.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and read the critique of GPTQ-style methods carefully. The three failure modes to keep in mind are uncorrected upstream perturbations, poor modeling of downstream sensitivity, and frozen second-order information inside a layer. Then move to the method overview and the derivation of Aggregated Fisher MSE, followed by the Block-GD algorithm. The main thing to understand is why the backpropagation can stay local to nearby blocks and why updating every 128 columns is a practical compromise.

In the results, prioritize the main comparison table and the ablations. The main table answers whether the method wins consistently; the ablations explain why. A useful skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. For deeper reading, check the appendix for complexity analysis, calibration-data details, and whether gains are consistent across model scales. Another important question is whether lower KL translates into better perplexity or generation quality in deployment, since that determines the practical meaning of the reported improvements.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain，但对“二阶 PTQ 足够好”的 prior 有实质修正；先看方法图和消融，重点判断动态更新的收益是否只在超低比特才成立。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it meaningfully challenges the prior that static second-order PTQ is good enough; read the method figure and ablations first, and check whether the gain only exists in ultra-low-bit regimes.

paper.title: HBQ: Hierarchical Scaling Block Quantization with Hardware-Efficiency-Aware Design for Accurate LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Block Quantization (BQ) is a promising approach for efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), enabling low-precision computation with controlled accuracy degradation. Compared to scalar weight-only quantization (WoQ), BQ quantizes both weight and activation, offering higher hardware efficiency and end-to-end inference on a unified datapath, but its design space, spanning bit-width, block size, scaling, and numeric formats, remains underexplored. We provide hardware/benchmark results

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 推理中 block quantization 在精度和硬件效率之间的冲突：大 block 更省硬件开销，但量化误差更难控制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理量化与硬件协同设计。它关注 weight 和 activation 同时量化的端到端低精度执行，而不是常见的 weight-only quantization；对预训练研究员的价值主要在于理解模型部署约束如何反向影响 activation 分布、数值格式和训练/校准策略。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先做硬件/benchmark 设计空间探索，系统考察 bit-width、block size、scaling 和 numeric format 的影响；核心方法 HBQ 使用更大的 block 来摊薄反量化与累加成本，同时引入低开销的层级 scaling 机制，试图补偿大 block 带来的精度损失。相对已有小 block PoT 或整数 scaling 方法，它更强调硬件数据通路一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明提供硬件和 benchmark 结果，并观察到 block size 增大能提升硬件效率但降低精度。具体 LLM 型号、参数规模、数据集、baseline 数值和提升幅度未在给定摘要中完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in LLM block quantization: larger blocks improve hardware efficiency but make quantization error harder to control.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference quantization and hardware-aware design contribution. It focuses on end-to-end low-precision execution with both weights and activations quantized, rather than conventional weight-only quantization. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is how deployment constraints feed back into activation statistics, numeric formats, and calibration design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first performs hardware and benchmark-driven design space exploration over bit-width, block size, scaling, and numeric format. HBQ then uses large blocks to amortize dequantization and accumulation overhead, while adding a low-overhead hierarchical scaling mechanism to recover accuracy. Compared with prior small-block PoT or integer-scaling designs, it is more explicitly optimized for a unified hardware datapath.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports hardware and benchmark evaluations and identifies the core trade-off that larger blocks improve efficiency but hurt accuracy. The provided excerpt does not specify the LLM families, parameter sizes, datasets, baselines, or exact numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 DSE 结论和 HBQ scaling 设计；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但能提醒量化友好激活分布应更早纳入约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the DSE findings and HBQ scaling design; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it is a useful reminder that quantization-friendly activation statistics should be considered earlier.

paper.title: Q-Strata: Hierarchical Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) assigns a different bitwidth to each linear layer of a large language model (LLM) to minimize the quantization-induced quality loss under a fixed budget, but Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models contain these layers in every expert of every MoE block, so the allocation space grows far larger than in a dense model. Existing methods either allocate within each block under a uniform per-block budget, or allocate across blocks through an additive proxy, and neither dire

summary.core_problem: 如何在混合精度量化（MPQ）中，为包含大量线性层的混合专家（MoE）模型高效分配比特位宽，以在固定预算下最小化质量损失？
summary.importance: 针对 MoE 模型量化空间巨大的问题，提出了一种双层分配器 Q-Strata，能够直接优化模型级别的目标，而不是像现有方法那样局限于块内或使用简单的加性代理。
summary.technical_approach: Q-Strata 采用双层分配策略：内层使用廉价代理对块内分配进行排序并缓存帕累托前沿；外层在组装的量化模型上评估模型级目标，为每个块设置一个预算，从而将搜索空间从每个线性层的位宽降低到每个块的预算。
summary.experiments: 在多个 MoE 模型上进行了实验，证明了 Q-Strata 在固定预算下能取得比现有方法更好的量化效果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自首尔大学，Hyun Oh Song 是机器学习领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to efficiently allocate bitwidths for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models with massive linear layers in mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) to minimize quality loss under a fixed budget?
summary_en.importance: Addresses the huge quantization space of MoE models by proposing Q-Strata, a bi-level allocator that directly optimizes a model-level objective, unlike existing methods confined to within-block allocation or simple additive proxies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Q-Strata uses a bi-level strategy: the inner stage ranks within-block assignments with a cheap proxy and caches a Pareto frontier; the outer stage evaluates a model-level objective on the assembled quantized model to set a budget per block, reducing the search space from bitwidths per linear layer to a budget per block.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on various MoE models demonstrate that Q-Strata achieves better quantization performance than existing methods under a fixed budget.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Seoul National University; Hyun Oh Song is a well-known scholar in machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 针对 MoE 模型的混合精度量化方法，双层分配策略设计巧妙，对做模型压缩和推理优化的研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A mixed-precision quantization method for MoE models with a clever bi-level allocation strategy, valuable for researchers working on model compression and inference optimization.

paper.title: H-Scale: Hessian-Guided Scale Refinement for NVFP4 Sub-Byte LLM Inference
paper.abstract: The NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, with native support for the ultra-fine-grained NVFP4 format, opens new opportunities for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference. NVFP4's micro-block design, such as a group size of 16, offers strong representational flexibility for capturing local weight distributions and isolating outliers, but it also introduces a large and highly sensitive space of per-group scaling factors. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods primarily focus on refi

summary.core_problem: NVFP4（Blackwell 原生支持的 4-bit 浮点）采用极细粒度 micro-block（如 group size=16）+ 每组 FP8 局部 scale 的设计。精度损失的关键不再只是“权重量化值怎么选”，而是“每组 scale 怎么校准”。论文要解决的是：在不改推理算子、不引入额外推理开销的前提下，如何更好地为每个 16 元素组选择硬件合法的 scale，从而显著缩小 NVFP4 与 BF16 的精度差距。
summary.importance: 这是推理侧 PTQ（post-training quantization）工作，但对基座研究员也有现实价值：1）Blackwell/NVFP4 可能成为新一代部署主流，scale 选择会成为新的误差主项；2）方法把“权重重构误差”升级为“输出敏感（activation/Hessian 加权）的重构误差”，与 GPTQ 的二阶思想同源，但落点在 scale 搜索，工程上更轻；3）提供了一个可插拔的后处理步骤，能叠加到现有 NVFP4 baseline 上，适合作为量化 pipeline 的默认组件。
summary.technical_approach:
H-Scale 的核心是把每组 scale 的选择问题写成一个输出重构目标，而不是最小化权重 MSE。设校准激活为 X，量化误差为 ΔW，则层输出误差为 ||XΔW^T||_F^2，其 Hessian 为 G=X^T X。直接用完整 G 会导致不同输入通道之间耦合，离散 scale 的联合搜索变成组合爆炸；作者用对角近似 diag(G) 得到每个输入通道的能量权重 h_j，从而把目标变成“按通道激活能量加权的重构误差”，并且在该近似下可按行、按组解耦。

算法上：先用常规 NVFP4 规则（通常由组内 max-abs 决定并 snap 到硬件可表示的 FP8 E4M3 scale）得到 baseline scale；然后对每个 group 枚举一个很小的邻域窗口（若干个相邻的、硬件合法的 FP8 scale 候选），对每个候选 scale 计算在对角 Hessian 权重下的重构代价，选最小者。注意它不改 FP4 的 value grid（E2M1）本身，也不引入额外参数；只是把“scale snap”从一次性规则变成了“局部离散搜索 + 输出敏感加权”。因此推理时仍是原生 NVFP4 解码，零额外开销；代价只发生在离线校准阶段，且可在分钟级完成。
summary.experiments: 从你提供的正文片段能确认的实验结论是定性的：作者在多个 SOTA LLM 上做了综合评测，H-Scale 相比多种 NVFP4 baseline 一般能带来更高的平均性能；在复杂推理类 benchmark 上，能进一步缩小 NVFP4 与 BF16 的平均差距；并强调对某些在 NVFP4 下变得不那么有效的技巧（如 Hadamard 预处理）之外，scale refinement 是新的关键杠杆。由于实验段落未包含在当前截取内容中，具体模型（如 Llama/Qwen/Mistral 等）、校准集大小 N、以及各 benchmark 的具体分数提升幅度无法在不臆测的情况下给出。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议：
1）Method 里从 ||XΔW^T|| 到 G=X^T X，再到对角近似的推导：这是“为什么可以逐组独立选 scale”的关键。
2）scale 枚举窗口的定义：候选 scale 如何在 E4M3 的离散集合上取“邻居”，窗口大小如何影响精度与校准耗时。
3）看作者是否报告了：不同层类型（attention/MLP、QKV/O）对 scale refinement 的敏感性；以及与 GPTQ/SpinQuant 等 weight-centric 方法叠加时的增益是否可加。
4）如果你关心训练-推理闭环：留意是否讨论了 activation 校准集分布漂移对 h_j 的影响，以及是否需要 per-domain 校准。

预计阅读时间：方法 20 分钟 + 实验 20–30 分钟；若要落地到量化 pipeline，建议边读边对照实现细节（scale snap、E2M1 clip 范围 [-6,6]、group=16 的布局）。

summary_en.core_problem: NVFP4 on NVIDIA Blackwell uses ultra-fine micro-block quantization (e.g., group size 16) with a per-group FP8 local scale. In this regime, accuracy is often dominated not only by the FP4 value rounding but by scale miscalibration across a huge number of groups. The paper addresses: how to refine hardware-valid per-group scales in a lightweight, post-processing PTQ step, with zero inference-time overhead.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference/PTQ contribution, but it matters to foundation-model practitioners because NVFP4 is likely to become a common deployment target and shifts the bottleneck toward scale calibration. Conceptually, it brings second-order/activation-aware weighting (in the spirit of GPTQ) to the scale-selection step rather than the weight-value optimization step, and it is designed as a drop-in refinement that can sit on top of existing NVFP4 pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
H-Scale replaces plain weight MSE with an output-aware reconstruction objective. With calibration activations X and quantization error ΔW, the layer output mismatch is ||XΔW^T||_F^2, whose Hessian is G = X^T X. Optimizing discrete per-group scales under full G would couple channels and make the search combinatorial. The method uses a diagonal approximation diag(G), yielding per-input-channel energy weights h_j that still capture which channels matter most.

Algorithmically, it starts from a baseline NVFP4 scale per group (typically max-abs then snapped to an E4M3-representable FP8 scale). For each group, it enumerates a small neighborhood of nearby hardware-valid FP8 scales around the baseline and selects the one minimizing the diagonal-Hessian-weighted reconstruction error. The FP4 grid (E2M1) and the inference kernel remain unchanged, so runtime cost is identical; the extra work is only an offline calibration-time refinement that runs in minutes.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided excerpt, the reported findings are: across multiple modern LLMs and several NVFP4 baselines, H-Scale generally improves average accuracy; on harder reasoning benchmarks it reduces the average gap between NVFP4 and BF16 in several settings; and it highlights that some previously effective tricks (e.g., Hadamard preprocessing) transfer less well to NVFP4, making scale refinement a key lever. The excerpt does not include the detailed experimental tables/figures, so exact model lists, calibration set sizes, and numeric deltas cannot be quoted without guessing.
summary_en.reading_guide: What to read closely: (1) the derivation from output reconstruction to G=X^T X and the diagonal surrogate—this is the justification for per-group independent scale search; (2) how the candidate-scale window is defined over the discrete E4M3 set and how window size trades accuracy vs calibration time; (3) whether gains are additive when combined with weight-centric PTQ methods (GPTQ/SpinQuant) and which layers benefit most (QKV vs MLP projections). If you care about robustness, check any discussion on calibration distribution shift and sensitivity of h_j to the calibration set. Time: ~40–60 minutes for method + experiments.

recommendation.zh: 只看 scale 搜索目标和校准激活近似；若内部要上 Blackwell FP4，应复现实验而不是只信 PTQ 曲线。
recommendation.en: Read the scale objective and activation-based proxy; if Blackwell FP4 is on your roadmap, reproduce it internally rather than trusting PTQ curves.

paper.title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels
paper.abstract: Edge LLM deployment is shaped by more than model size and precision: inference backend, hardware platform, memory traffic, and power management all affect latency and efficiency. We present Hydra, a common-schema, phase-aware workload characterization framework for LLM inference on edge SoCs. Hydra instruments HuggingFace Transformers and llama.cpp with a shared per-prompt timing schema and fuses those records with hardware telemetry, enabling a multi-dimensional characterization of performance,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是某个新推理算法，而是 edge SoC 上 LLM 推理缺少统一、分阶段、可归因的测量框架。现有研究常见问题有三个：只看单一平台，难以比较代际变化；只测一种后端，HuggingFace 和 llama.cpp 的差异无法在同一口径下分析；只报端到端延迟或平均功耗，prefill 和 decode 的资源行为被混在一起。论文要解决的是，如何把不同 SoC、不同后端、不同量化格式、不同模型的推理行为放到同一 phase-aware schema 下，做可复现、可解释的 workload characterization。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对基座模型部署和推理研究有方法论价值。它的重要性主要体现在测量层，而不是算法层。第一，它把 prefill/decode 作为一等分析对象，而不是只看总 latency，这和服务端 LLM 研究的分析方式接上了。第二，它把 timing 与硬件遥测对齐，能解释为什么某种量化或后端在 edge 上未必带来预期收益。第三，它给出跨 SoC 代际、跨 backend、跨 precision 的统一 schema，这对后续做 edge serving、量化策略、系统 co-design 的工作是一个比较扎实的基线工具。若从“对预训练研究有没有启发”来讲，启发主要在于：模型设计和量化格式的收益高度依赖部署环境，不能把 datacenter 上的结论直接外推到 edge。
summary.technical_approach: Hydra 的核心不是新执行引擎，而是一套统一测量接口。作者分别对 HuggingFace Transformers 和 llama.cpp 做 instrumentation，让两条结构差异很大的推理路径都输出同一种 per-prompt timing record。这个 canonical schema 至少覆盖 tokenization、prefill、逐 token generation、de-tokenization、ITL 和 end-to-end latency。然后再把这些阶段边界与 tegrastats、NVML 等高频硬件遥测对齐，得到 CPU、GPU、DRAM、功耗、能耗、温度等指标在 prefill 和 decode 窗口内的归因。方法上的关键点有两个。第一，测量接口与执行配置解耦，所以可以在不改分析管线的情况下替换模型、量化格式、prompt 长度和 SoC 代际。第二，它同时覆盖 Python 框架路径和 GGML/C++ 路径，这比只测单一 backend 更接近真实部署选择。论文实例化了三代 Jetson 平台：AGX Xavier、AGX Orin、AGX Thor；两类后端：HF 与 llama.cpp；13 个 instruction-tuned 模型，来自 7 个家族；5 种执行格式：bf16、F16、Q8_0、Q6_K、Q4_K_M。分析维度包括端到端延迟、decode throughput、输入输出长度敏感性、CPU 运行时行为、GPU 有效利用率、DRAM 流量、功耗、每 token 能耗、总 prompt 能耗和热行为。
summary.experiments: 从全文可提炼出的关键结果不是某个单点最优，而是几条稳定结论。第一，性能由 backend、模型架构、precision 和序列长度共同决定，单看模型大小不够。Hydra 的 phase timing 显示，backend overhead、量化后的 decode throughput、以及输入输出长度扩展，分别作用在推理流水线的不同部分。第二，量化通常能降低 DRAM 流量和模型 footprint，但不必然降低延迟或能耗，因为 edge SoC 上还受 CPU 侧调度、GPU 利用率、共享内存带宽、DVFS 和热约束影响。第三，不同后端的 CPU orchestration 成本差异明显，这会改变 decode 阶段的有效吞吐和能效。第四，跨代 SoC 的收益也不是线性放大；新一代平台在某些配置下能显著改善吞吐或能效，但在另一些配置下会被后端开销或热限制部分抵消。论文强调 phase-aligned telemetry 的必要性：如果只看 run-averaged power 或总 latency，会看不到 prefill 与 decode 在功耗和内存行为上的显著差异。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，全文的价值也确实更偏分析框架和趋势归因，而不是追求一个统一的性能冠军。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，不需要逐节细抠。先看 Introduction，把作者指出的三个方法学缺口记住；再看 Hydra 的 schema 设计和 instrumentation 方式，理解它如何把 HF 与 llama.cpp 拉到同一测量口径；最后看结果部分里 phase-level timing、resource utilization、energy/thermal 三组图。重点不是记住哪台 Jetson 快多少，而是看作者如何用对齐后的 telemetry 解释性能差异。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主要信息。若要深挖，建议关注：1）phase 边界定义是否足够稳健；2）不同量化格式在不同 backend 上的 kernel 实现差异是否会影响结论可迁移性；3）共享内存 SoC 上 KV cache、权重访问和 CPU orchestration 的相互作用是否还能进一步建模。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper does not propose a new inference algorithm. It addresses a measurement problem: edge-SoC LLM inference lacks a unified, phase-aware, and attributable characterization framework. Prior studies often focus on a single platform, a single backend, or aggregate metrics such as end-to-end latency and average power. That makes it hard to compare SoC generations, hard to align HuggingFace and llama.cpp under one methodology, and hard to explain how prefill and decode stress the system differently. Hydra is designed to provide a common schema for such analysis.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining is limited, but the methodological value for foundation-model deployment is real. The main contribution is measurement discipline rather than a new serving primitive. It treats prefill and decode as first-class phases, aligns timing with hardware telemetry, and exposes why quantization or backend choices may behave differently on edge devices than on datacenter GPUs. For researchers working on model design, quantization, or serving co-design, the paper is a useful reminder that deployment conclusions are hardware- and backend-dependent, especially on unified-memory, power-constrained SoCs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hydra is a common-schema instrumentation and analysis framework. The authors instrument both HuggingFace Transformers and llama.cpp so that two very different inference stacks emit the same per-prompt timing record. The canonical schema covers at least tokenization, prefill, per-token generation, de-tokenization, inter-token latency, and end-to-end latency. These phase boundaries are then fused with high-resolution telemetry from tegrastats and NVML, enabling attribution of CPU activity, GPU utilization, DRAM traffic, power, energy, and thermal behavior to the prefill and decode windows. Two design choices matter. First, the measurement interface is decoupled from execution configuration, so models, precisions, prompt lengths, and SoC generations can be swapped without changing the analysis pipeline. Second, the framework spans both the Python framework path and the GGML/C++ path, which makes the comparison more realistic for deployment. The instantiated study covers three Jetson generations—AGX Xavier, AGX Orin, and AGX Thor—two backends, 13 instruction-tuned models from seven families, and five execution formats: bf16, F16, Q8_0, Q6_K, and Q4_K_M.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is more about stable findings than about one best number. First, performance depends jointly on backend, architecture, precision, and sequence length; model size alone is not predictive enough. Hydra’s phase-level timing shows that backend overhead, quantized decode throughput, and input/output-length scaling affect different parts of the inference pipeline. Second, quantization often reduces DRAM traffic and model footprint, but it does not automatically reduce latency or energy on edge SoCs, because CPU orchestration, GPU effective utilization, shared-memory bandwidth, DVFS, and thermal limits also matter. Third, backend choice changes CPU-side runtime behavior enough to alter decode throughput and efficiency. Fourth, gains across SoC generations are not uniformly realized; newer hardware can improve throughput or energy efficiency in some settings, but backend overheads or thermal constraints can offset part of the benefit in others. A central empirical point is that phase-aligned telemetry is necessary: aggregate latency or run-averaged power hides meaningful differences between prefill and decode.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and note the three methodological gaps the authors identify. Then read the Hydra schema and instrumentation design to understand how HuggingFace and llama.cpp are brought under one measurement interface. Finally, inspect the result sections on phase-level timing, resource utilization, and energy/thermal behavior. The goal is not to memorize which Jetson variant wins, but to see how aligned telemetry is used to explain performance differences. A useful first pass should take 20–30 minutes. If you want to go deeper, check how robust the phase boundary definitions are, whether backend-specific kernel implementations limit the portability of the conclusions, and how unified-memory effects interact with KV cache access, weight traffic, and CPU orchestration.

recommendation.zh: 读 Fig/表里 prefill-decode 分相结果即可；它提醒架构 ablation 别用单一 latency 数字下结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the prefill-vs-decode breakdowns; the useful lesson is not to draw architecture conclusions from one aggregate latency number.

paper.title: FAMPWQ: Fisher Information-based Adaptive Mixed Precision Weight Quantization for Effective LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable achievements of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multiple domains, while the excessive resource requirements of LLMs hinder the deployment on resource-constrained devices. Although model quantization stands out as an effective approach, conventional quantization approaches typically incur severe performance degradation due to uniform bit-width or simple heuristic sensitivity evaluation. In this paper, we propose a novel Fisher information-based Adaptive Mixe

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在资源受限设备上部署时，统一位宽量化带来的精度损失过大问题。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率方向的常规改进：把层敏感度估计和混合精度分配结合起来，目标是更稳地压缩权重位宽。对预训练本身帮助有限，但对理解哪些层更脆弱有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FAMPWQ，用 Fisher information 估计层级量化敏感度，再用强化学习搜索每层 bit-width 分配策略，形成自适应混合精度权重量化方案，面向 commodity GPU 推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 7 个模型上做实验，但未给出具体模型规模、量化配置、基线名称和提升幅度。按摘要看，主要比较对象是统一位宽或启发式敏感度量化方法，结论是能在较低资源下保持更好性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the accuracy drop caused by uniform-bit quantization when deploying LLMs under tight resource constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a fairly standard inference-efficiency paper: it combines layer sensitivity estimation with mixed-precision allocation. It is only indirectly useful for pretraining researchers, mainly as a signal about layer fragility.
summary_en.technical_approach: FAMPWQ uses a Fisher-information-based metric to estimate layer-wise quantization sensitivity, then applies an RL-based allocator to assign per-layer bit widths for adaptive mixed-precision weight quantization on commodity GPUs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions experiments on seven models, but does not provide model sizes, quantization settings, baselines, or exact gains. From the abstract, the main comparison is against uniform-bit or heuristic sensitivity methods, with better accuracy-resource trade-offs claimed.

recommendation.zh: 量化老题目的正常增量，预训练研究员只需看敏感度定义和分层分配结果；若实验没覆盖长上下文与校准集漂移，结论别放太重。
recommendation.en: A routine quantization increment; only the sensitivity metric and per-layer allocation patterns are worth a look, and treat claims lightly if calibration drift and long-context behavior are missing.

paper.title: SandwichQuant: Which Parameters Matter Before and After Quantization?
paper.abstract: Quantization correction methods usually optimize weights, quantization parameters, or reconstruction objectives, while the underlying parameter subspaces responsible for effective correction remain unclear. In this work, we study quantization correction from a parameter subspace perspective and reveal that correction capability is highly non-uniform across parameter groups. By decomposing trainable parameters into backbone weights, normalization-affine parameters, and quantization parameters, we

summary.core_problem: 极低比特 PTQ/QAT 下，模型精度下降通常被归因于“量化器设计/舍入/重建目标不够好”，但到底哪些参数子空间最能用来做量化误差修复并不清楚。论文要回答的是：在固定量化图（权重量化、激活量化、甚至 KV 量化）后，若只允许很小的可训练预算，更新哪些参数最划算？以及这些更新应该发生在量化前（影响校准分布）还是量化后（修复残差误差）？
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接启发在于：它把“低比特鲁棒性”解释为一个可分析的参数子空间问题，而不是纯粹的量化工程技巧。结论是：归一化层的仿射参数（RMSNorm/LayerNorm 的 gamma/beta 或仅 gamma）虽然维度很小，但对响应分布有广播式控制力，在匹配优化预算时往往比同预算的权重子空间更能修复可恢复的量化误差。这会影响大模型训练与架构选择：
- 归一化参数的可塑性是低比特部署的重要杠杆，训练时如何设置 norm（RMSNorm vs LN、是否有 beta、初始化与正则）会影响后续 PTQ 的可修复空间。
- “量化前预条件 + 量化后残差修复”的两阶段思路，提供了一个比单次校准更稳定的接口，适合做持续部署/持续量化的工程闭环。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把可训练状态分解为三组坐标：骨干权重 W、归一化仿射参数 Φ、量化器参数 Ω（scale/zero-point/rounding/rotation 等，取决于 PTQ backend）。核心做法是用“同量级优化预算”的受控实验比较不同子空间的纠错能力，并给出机制解释。
方法 SandwichQuant 是两阶段、都只训练 Φ：
1）SandwichQuant-Pre：在量化前，先在浮点模型上微调归一化仿射参数 Φ_pre。目的不是直接适配低比特算子，而是改变激活/响应分布，让后续 PTQ 校准与重建更容易（作者称为 distribution preconditioning）。然后把学到的 Φ_pre 迁回原始 dense checkpoint（其余权重不动），重新从头跑一次选定的 PTQ backend（包含校准、舍入、剪裁、旋转、重建等）。
2）SandwichQuant-Post：得到量化后的低比特图后，冻结量化图与权重，只再训练一份独立的 Φ_post，用来修复量化后仍残留的响应失配（residual response correction）。
关键点在于：两阶段分别作用在“进入 PTQ 的分布”与“PTQ 后的残差误差”，避免把两种目标混在一次优化里；同时只改动网络中原生存在的 norm 仿射参数，不引入额外推理分支或新算子，部署成本低。
论文还强调边界：Φ 的确能修复结构化的响应偏移与误差传播，但对严重 clipping/rounding 造成的信息不可逆损失无能为力，因此它的收益取决于量化误差中“可恢复部分”的占比与对齐程度。
summary.experiments:
作者在三个 LLM 家族、多个 PTQ backends 上报告一致收益，覆盖 weight-only（如 W3A16）以及更激进的联合量化设置（如 W2A4KV4：权重 2bit、激活 4bit、KV 4bit）。主要指标包括困惑度下降与 zero-shot 平均准确率提升，并声称完整的 Pre+Post 组合优于只做 Pre 或只做 Post。
实验设计的关键是“matched budgets”：在相同训练步数/数据/可训练参数规模约束下，对比更新 Φ 与更新同规模的 W 子空间，显示 Φ 子空间的纠错效率更高。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体模型名称、校准数据规模、各 setting 的困惑度/准确率数字表；精确数字需要对照论文主表与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction 里对 Θ=(W,Φ,Ω) 的问题设定与“子空间纠错”视角，理解它想证明的不是一个小技巧，而是纠错能力的非均匀性。
- 重点看方法部分对 SandwichQuant-Pre/Post 的训练顺序与“重新跑 PTQ backend”的细节：哪些量化步骤会被 Φ_pre 影响（校准/剪裁/重建），哪些不会。
- 精读 matched-budget 对照实验与消融：Pre-only、Post-only、Pre+Post；以及 Φ vs 同预算 W 的对比，这是论文最有信息量的证据链。
- 如果要落地：关注它对不同 PTQ backend 的兼容性、校准数据需求、以及在 W2A4KV4 这类极端设置下收益是否仍稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Under extreme low-bit PTQ/QAT (including joint quantization of weights/activations/KV), accuracy drops are usually tackled via better quantizers, rounding, or reconstruction objectives. What remains unclear is which parameter subspaces are actually effective for post-quantization correction under tight adaptation budgets, and whether those corrections should happen before quantization (to shape calibration distributions) or after quantization (to fix residual functional mismatch).
summary_en.importance: The main value is conceptual and practical: it reframes quantization robustness as a parameter-subspace problem. Normalization affine parameters (LN/RMSNorm gamma/beta) are tiny in dimension but have broadcast control over channel-wise responses, making them disproportionately effective for correcting the recoverable part of quantization error under matched optimization budgets. For foundation-model work, this suggests (i) norm design and norm-parameter plasticity materially affect deployability at low bits, and (ii) a clean two-stage interface—preconditioning before PTQ plus residual correction after PTQ—can be a stable deployment loop without touching backbone weights.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper decomposes trainable state as Θ=(W, Φ, Ω): backbone weights W, normalization affine parameters Φ, and quantizer parameters Ω (scales/zero-points/rounding/rotations depending on the PTQ backend). It then runs controlled, matched-budget comparisons across these coordinate subspaces to identify where correction leverage concentrates.
SandwichQuant is a two-stage framework that only updates Φ:
1) Pre stage (SandwichQuant-Pre): train Φ_pre on the dense model to precondition response distributions presented to PTQ calibration/reconstruction. Then transfer only Φ_pre back to the original dense checkpoint and rerun the chosen PTQ backend from scratch.
2) Post stage (SandwichQuant-Post): after PTQ produces a fixed low-bit graph, freeze the quantized model and learn an independent Φ_post to correct residual response mismatch.
The separation matters: Φ_pre influences calibration/clipping/reconstruction by reshaping activations, while Φ_post targets remaining functional error after the quantized graph is fixed. The method adds no new inference modules/operators—only reuses existing norm affine parameters.
Mechanistically, the paper argues affine adaptation can fix structured response mismatch and error propagation, but cannot recover information irreversibly lost to severe clipping/rounding; gains depend on how much of the error is recoverable and aligned with the Φ subspace.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported across three LLM families and multiple PTQ backends, covering both weight-only regimes (e.g., W3A16) and aggressive joint quantization (e.g., W2A4KV4). Metrics include lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy, with Pre+Post consistently outperforming one-sided variants.
A key experimental pillar is matched-budget controls: under the same optimization budget, updating Φ yields stronger recovery than updating an equally sized subspace of W.
Note: the provided excerpt does not include the exact model names, calibration set sizes, or the full numeric tables; those should be taken from the main results/appendix for precise deltas.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the problem setup around Θ=(W,Φ,Ω) and the motivation for a subspace view.
- Focus on the exact SandwichQuant pipeline: when Φ_pre is trained, how it is transferred, and what “rerun PTQ from scratch” entails for the backend.
- Spend time on matched-budget experiments and ablations (Pre vs Post vs Pre+Post; Φ vs same-budget W). That is where the paper’s claim is actually supported.
- For deployment relevance, check backend compatibility, calibration data requirements, and stability in the harsh W2A4KV4 setting.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和参数组 ablation；若结果稳，norm-affine 可能是低成本 PTQ 修复的优先旋钮。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and parameter-group ablations; if the results hold, norm-affine tuning is a cheap first knob for PTQ repair.

paper.title: LLM4LLM: Bridging Kernel Benchmarks and Real Deployment via Closed-Loop Agentic Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models have become increasingly capable agents for low-level code and kernel optimization, but isolated kernel benchmarks provide only a proxy for the deployment behavior that matters in language-model inference. We identify a benchmark-to-deployment gap: candidate kernels that appear correct and fast in standalone harnesses can exhibit different performance, safety, or phase behavior after integration into a real inference workload. We introduce LLM4LLM, a deployment-aware closed

summary.core_problem: 如何弥合独立 kernel benchmark 与实际 LLM 推理部署之间的性能差距，实现端到端的 kernel 优化？
summary.importance: 指出了独立 kernel 评测的局限性，提出了一种闭环的 Agent 优化框架 LLM4LLM，通过在实际推理工作负载中验证和优化 kernel，显著提升了 LLM 的端到端推理速度。
summary.technical_approach: LLM4LLM 框架从目标推理脚本出发，提取感知阶段的优化任务，使用经验引导的 Agent 进行搜索，并通过模型内验证（in-model validation）来接受 patch，确保优化在实际部署中有效。
summary.experiments: 在 A100 和 H100 GPU 上对 10 个 LLM 推理工作负载进行了评估，LLM4LLM 实现了端到端延迟的显著改善（A100/H100 上分别达到 3.91x/6.98x 的几何平均加速比）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to bridge the performance gap between isolated kernel benchmarks and actual LLM inference deployment to achieve end-to-end kernel optimization?
summary_en.importance: Identifies the limitations of isolated kernel evaluation and proposes a closed-loop Agentic optimization framework, LLM4LLM, which significantly improves end-to-end LLM inference speed by validating and optimizing kernels within actual inference workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: The LLM4LLM framework starts from a target inference script, extracts phase-aware optimization tasks, searches with an experience-guided episodic agent, and accepts patches through in-model validation to ensure optimizations are effective in actual deployment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 10 LLM inference workloads on A100 and H100 GPUs, LLM4LLM achieved significant improvements in end-to-end latency (3.91x/6.98x geometric-mean speedups on A100/H100, respectively).

recommendation.zh: 用 Agent 做 kernel 优化并强调端到端验证，思路不错，但属于推理系统优化范畴，预训练研究员可快速浏览其 benchmark-to-deployment gap 的观点。
recommendation.en: Using an Agent for kernel optimization with an emphasis on end-to-end validation is a good idea, but it falls under inference system optimization; pretraining researchers can quickly glance at its perspective on the benchmark-to-deployment gap.

paper.title: COEC: Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation for Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Structured pruning reduces the size and inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by removing weight columns, but the resulting output error can degrade accuracy. Existing training-free compensation methods use an additive bias or a single orthogonal rotation on the output side of the retained weight. These corrections leave its input singular frame unchanged and therefore limit how the retained weight can adapt after column removal. We propose COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compen

summary.core_problem: 结构化剪枝（移除整列权重）会导致 LLM 精度下降，现有的免训练补偿方法（如仅添加偏置或单侧正交旋转）无法有效恢复被剪枝列所代表的输入相关性结构。
summary.importance: 提出了一种更精细的免训练结构化剪枝补偿框架，通过双侧正交旋转和逐模式缩放，更好地恢复了剪枝后的模型性能，对 LLM 压缩和推理优化具有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation)。该方法在保留的权重上交替应用左侧闭式正交旋转和右侧基于流形优化的正交旋转。同时，使用广义交叉验证（GCV）为每个奇异值模式独立选择正则化强度进行缩放。此外，引入了校准 Gram 矩阵的谱回火（平衡困惑度和零样本精度）以及层间对齐惩罚（恢复相邻层之间的几何关系）。COEC 仅依赖于从小校准集估计的二阶矩统计量，无需反向传播。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3、Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 模型系列上进行了评估。在相同的列选择下，COEC 在所有模型上都改善了困惑度，并在大多数设置下提高了零样本精度，尤其是在高剪枝率下提升更明显。作为插件应用于 Wanda-sp 和 FLAP 的选择结果时，COEC 恢复了大量因剪枝丢失的精度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议阅读 Introduction 了解现有方法的局限性，以及 Problem Formulation 中对双侧旋转和逐模式缩放的数学描述。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Structured pruning (removing entire weight columns) degrades LLM accuracy, and existing training-free compensation methods (like adding bias or single-sided orthogonal rotation) fail to effectively recover the input correlation structure represented by the pruned columns.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a more refined training-free compensation framework for structured pruning. By employing two-sided orthogonal rotations and per-mode scaling, it better recovers post-pruning model performance, offering practical value for LLM compression and inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation). It applies alternating closed-form left orthogonal rotation and manifold-optimized right orthogonal rotation to the retained weights. It also uses generalized cross-validation (GCV) to independently select regularization strength for scaling each singular mode. Additionally, it introduces spectral tempering of the calibration Gram matrix (to balance perplexity and zero-shot accuracy) and an inter-layer alignment penalty (to restore geometric relations between adjacent layers). COEC relies only on second-moment statistics estimated from a small calibration set and requires no backpropagation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama-3, Llama-3.1, and Qwen2.5 families. Under identical column selections, COEC improves perplexity across all models and zero-shot accuracy in most settings, with larger gains at higher pruning ratios. When applied as a plug-in to Wanda-sp and FLAP selections, COEC recovers a substantial portion of the accuracy lost during pruning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction to understand the limitations of existing methods, and the Problem Formulation for the mathematical description of two-sided rotation and per-mode scaling. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但若你做压缩，这篇比常见 bias/单旋转补偿更像样；重点看双侧正交补偿是否真在高剪枝率下稳定，而不是只赢低难度设置。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about compression, this is more substantive than the usual bias/single-rotation fixes; check whether the bi-sided orthogonal compensation still holds at aggressive pruning ratios.

paper.title: SoftWater: Class-Aware Rate Allocation for Softmax Quantization
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization pipelines routinely leave the softmax output layer in high precision. Yet in small LLMs with modern vocabularies, the head holds 15--30\% of all parameters, so a nominal ``2-bit'' model with an fp16 head can store several times as many bits per weight. We pose softmax-layer quantization as a rate-distortion problem under the KL divergence between the original and quantized output distributions. A second-order analysis reveals a class-aware geometry: quantization error

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化通常把语言模型输出头保留在 fp16，因为线性层常用的加权 MSE 目标不直接匹配 softmax 后的概率失真。在小模型加大词表的设定下，输出头可占全部参数的 15%–30%，导致标称 2-bit 模型实际平均位宽接近 5 bit。问题是如何在 KL 散度意义下量化 softmax 输出层，并按类别合理分配比特。
summary.importance: 对推理部署和小模型存储效率有直接价值。它把输出头量化从“留高精度”变成可按率失真优化的问题，并指出词表分布的 Zipf 性质使类别间比特分配差异很大。对预训练研究者的启发主要在词表尺寸、输出头参数占比与部署成本之间的权衡，以及校准分布如何携带领域信息。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是把输出层量化写成原始分布与量化分布之间的 KL 率失真问题。二阶展开显示，KL 的 Hessian 为 (diag(p) - pp^T) ⊗ XX^T，既依赖输入特征协方差，也依赖类别概率曲率。工作采用可分离近似：用 λ̄_k = E[p_k(1-p_k)] 描述类别侧尺度，用特征协方差的 Cholesky 对角元描述列侧尺度。于是高频、低方差类别获得更细网格，稀有类别获得更粗网格。编码复用 WaterSIC 的 successive interference cancellation 格型量化，只在校准中增加一个对角累积量。为避免稀有类别上 Taylor 展开不可信，又加入先验平滑来约束网格间距；平滑权重趋于均匀时退化为 WaterSIC 的 WMSE 处理。
summary.experiments: 在 1B 到 32B 的五个模型上测试。SoftWater 在匹配输出头比特率时，于 60 个测试点中的 59 个超过已发布的 WaterSIC 量化器，而且没有使用 WaterSIC 管线中的若干改进技巧。方法也可直接迁移到使用 GuidedQuant 主体量化的模型。类别侧因子能携带协方差之外的领域信息，使输出头可按部署领域定向；整体模型体积最多可减少约 60%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看引言中的 Table 1，理解输出头参数占比为何使“2-bit”标称失真；再看第 3–4 节的 KL 二阶展开、可分离近似和先验平滑。第 5 节重点看与 WaterSIC 的对比、跨模型迁移，以及类别分配带来的体积下降。若只关心工程结论，可跳过部分格率证明，保留 λ̄_k 和 Cholesky 对角元如何决定网格这一主线。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training quantization pipelines usually keep the LM head in fp16 because the standard weighted-MSE objective for linear layers does not match the distortion of the softmax output distribution. In small models with modern vocabularies, the head accounts for 15%–30% of all parameters, so a nominal 2-bit model can effectively store close to 5 bits per weight. The problem is how to quantize the softmax head under KL divergence and allocate bits across vocabulary classes.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to deployment and small-model storage. It turns the output head from a layer that is simply left in high precision into a rate-distortion problem, and shows that the Zipfian token distribution creates large gaps in class-wise bit allocation. For pretraining research, it is useful as a reminder of how vocabulary size and head parameter count interact with deployment cost, and how calibration distributions encode domain-specific allocation signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: SoftWater formulates head quantization as rate-distortion under output KL. A second-order expansion gives the Hessian (diag(p) - pp^T) ⊗ XX^T, coupling class-specific softmax curvature with input feature covariance. A separable approximation uses λ̄_k = E[p_k(1-p_k)] for the class scale and the Cholesky diagonal of the feature covariance for the column scale. Frequent, low-variance classes receive finer grids; rare classes receive coarser grids. The method reuses WaterSIC’s successive-interference-cancellation lattice encoder and adds only one diagonal accumulator during calibration. A prior smooths the calibration distribution to cap grid spacing for poorly covered classes, keeping the allocation in the regime where the Taylor expansion is reliable; the smoothing limit recovers WaterSIC’s uniform-class WMSE treatment.
summary_en.experiments: Across five models ranging from 1B to 32B parameters, SoftWater outperforms the released WaterSIC quantizer at matched head rates on 59 of 60 test points without using WaterSIC’s additional refinements. It also transfers unchanged to models whose bodies are quantized with GuidedQuant. The class-side factor carries domain information beyond feature covariance, allowing head allocation to target a deployment domain, and reduces whole-model size by up to 60%.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, start with Table 1 in the introduction to see why the head makes nominal 2-bit numbers misleading. Then read Sections 3–4 for the KL expansion, separable approximation, and smoothing prior. Section 5 is the main empirical section: compare against WaterSIC, check transfer to GuidedQuant bodies, and inspect the size-reduction results. The lattice-rate proofs can be skipped unless the reader needs the precise connection between the Cholesky diagonal, class scales, and entropy-coded bit rate.

recommendation.zh: 小模型 LM head 不能默认留 fp16；读二阶 KL 推导和分配规则，可补端到端低比特部署的盲点。
recommendation.en: The LM head cannot be casually left in fp16 for small models; read the second-order KL derivation and allocation rule for a concrete low-bit deployment fix.

paper.title: ReQuant: Fixed-Grid Discrete Refinement for Post-Training Quantization
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the memory and computational cost of large language models. Existing PTQ methods typically obtain an initial quantized model through heuristic rules or greedy optimization, and once quantization is completed the resulting integer assignments are usually treated as final. This observation motivates a complementary optimization stage within PTQ that keeps quantized weights improvable after an executable quantized model has been produced, wh

summary.core_problem: 在不改变任何部署格式（bit-width / scale / zero-point / grid layout / kernel）的前提下，如何在“已经量化完成、可直接执行”的 PTQ 模型上继续做离散优化，把先前一次性/贪心量化留下的次优整数码（integer codes）进一步改好，并且不引入反向传播或额外训练。
summary.importance: 对大模型推理侧的直接意义更大：它把 PTQ 从“一次性生成最终整数码”改成“先得到可用解，再做固定网格上的离散精修”的两阶段流程。对预训练研究的启发主要在工程接口：1）量化不再是不可逆的终点，允许在不触碰训练数据与梯度的情况下做可控的后处理；2）对低比特（W3/W2、A4）尤其有效，能把一些激进压缩从‘不可用’拉回到‘可用’，从而影响模型发布与迭代节奏；3）方法对上游 PTQ 初始化器（GPTQ/GPTAQ/AWQ/简单 rounding 等）相对无关，适合作为统一的“最后一公里”模块。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设定是 fixed-grid discrete refinement：输入是一个已经量化好的权重矩阵（以及其 scale/zero-point 等量化参数），这些量化参数全部冻结，只允许修改每个权重元素对应的整数码。

目标函数沿用重构误差（reconstruction loss）思路，但强调推理时的 activation mismatch：层输入来自“前缀已量化”的网络而不是全精度网络，因此采用类似 GPTAQ 的 activation-aware 目标，用校准集分别跑全精度/部分量化前缀收集 X 与 \tilde{X}，在更贴近真实推理分布的激活上做重构。

优化上强调 backprop-free：不做 STE、不做梯度下降，而是把问题当作离散坐标更新（integer code 的局部搜索/迭代改进）。论文把 ReQuant 定位为可组合的 PTQ 后处理 stage：从任意 PTQ 产物出发，按 sweep 迭代地“重新审视”部分权重的离散赋值，只接受能降低总体重构损失的更新，因此保证重构损失单调不增，并在有限次接受更新后终止。

从实现取舍看，它刻意冻结量化网格与推理 kernel，避免引入新的部署复杂度；代价是搜索空间受限，只能在既定网格上挪动整数码，因此收益依赖于上游网格/scale 选择是否合理。论文也强调离线预算可控：用 sweep 次数 T 控制精修强度，复杂度与一次 GPTAQ pass 同量级。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称在 Llama-3 8B/70B、Qwen3-14B 的多种设置下（W4A16、W4A4、W3A4、W2A4）相对四个 PTQ baseline 同时改善 perplexity、KL divergence 与 zero-shot accuracy，且“初始化越简单、bit 越低收益越大”。另外给出：
- 与 FlexRound 的 W4A16 pipeline 对比，用于说明在常见 4bit 权重量化下也能带来额外收益；
- paired GPTQ ± ReQuant：在同一 GPTQ 初始化上加/不加 ReQuant，隔离出纯 refinement 的增益；
- Qwen3-235B MoE：展示在超大 MoE 上可跑通，强调可扩展性。

但在当前提供的正文片段中，关键数字（具体 PPL/准确率提升幅度、校准集大小、每层/每 sweep 的耗时、不同 bit 下收益曲线）尚未出现；精读时需要回到实验章节核对：收益是否主要来自少数层、是否对校准集分布敏感、以及 T 增大后的边际收益与时间成本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1）先看 Figure 1（论文在引言里提到）理解它要解决的“PTQ 把整数码当最终解”的结构性问题，以及 ReQuant 在 pipeline 中的位置。
2）方法部分重点抓三件事：activation-aware 的目标如何构造（X 与 \tilde{X} 的采集方式）、离散更新的单位与接受准则（如何保证 loss 下降、为何有限步终止）、以及每次 sweep 的计算复杂度如何做到接近 GPTAQ。
3）实验部分建议按“paired study（GPTQ ± ReQuant）→ 低比特（W3/W2, A4）→ 大模型/MoE 可扩展性”的顺序读，优先确认：收益是否稳定、是否依赖特定初始化器、以及离线预算 T 的可控性。

预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可把方法与主要结论读清；若要复现，需要额外关注实现细节（校准集构造、层级处理顺序、与现有 kernel 的对齐）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to further improve an already-deployed PTQ model by refining its discrete integer weight codes on a fixed quantization grid—without changing bit-width/scales/zero-points/kernels, and without backpropagation—so that the initial greedy/heuristic PTQ assignment is no longer treated as final.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-side contribution, but it changes the practical PTQ interface for foundation models: PTQ becomes a two-stage pipeline (get an executable quantized model first, then do discrete refinement). For pretraining teams, the value is operational: it can rescue aggressive low-bit settings (e.g., W3/W2 with A4) into usable regimes, and it is largely initializer-agnostic, making it a drop-in “last-mile” module across GPTQ/GPTAQ/AWQ-style pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ReQuant is framed as fixed-grid discrete refinement. The quantization format is frozen (bit-width, scale, zero-point, grid layout, inference kernels). The only variables are the integer codes assigned to weights.

The objective follows reconstruction-based PTQ, with an explicit focus on activation mismatch: at inference, a layer sees activations produced by a quantized prefix. Similar to GPTAQ, it uses activation-aware reconstruction by collecting activations from (i) the full-precision model and (ii) the partially-quantized model to obtain \tilde{X}, then optimizes reconstruction under the more realistic activation distribution.

Optimization is backprop-free: instead of STE/gradient descent, it performs iterative discrete updates over integer codes (a coordinate-style local search). Updates are accepted only if they reduce the overall reconstruction loss, yielding monotonic loss decrease and finite termination (a finite number of accepted updates). The offline budget is controlled by the number of sweeps T, and the per-sweep cost is argued to be comparable to a GPTAQ pass.

A key design trade-off is deliberate: by freezing the grid and kernels, deployment complexity stays unchanged, but the search is constrained to the existing grid, so gains depend on the upstream choice of scales/grid being reasonable.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported results cover Llama-3 8B/70B and Qwen3-14B across W4A16, W4A4, W3A4, and W2A4, improving perplexity, KL divergence, and zero-shot accuracy over multiple PTQ baselines, with larger gains at lower bit-widths and weaker initializers. Additional studies include: (1) W4A16 pipeline comparisons with FlexRound, (2) a paired GPTQ ± ReQuant ablation to isolate refinement gains, and (3) a Qwen3-235B MoE run to demonstrate scalability.

The provided excerpt does not include the key quantitative tables/curves (exact PPL deltas, accuracy deltas, calibration size, runtime per sweep, diminishing returns vs T). Those are the first things to verify in the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Start with the pipeline illustration (Figure 1) to internalize the “PTQ output is not final” premise and where ReQuant plugs in.
- In the method section, focus on: how activation-aware reconstruction is formed (X vs \tilde{X}), what the discrete update/acceptance rule is (why loss is guaranteed to decrease, why it terminates), and how the sweep complexity matches GPTAQ.
- In experiments, read in this order: paired GPTQ ± ReQuant → low-bit settings (W3/W2 with A4) → large-scale/MoE feasibility, and check sensitivity to initializer and calibration data.

Time: ~30–45 minutes to understand the method and main claims; longer if you want implementation-level details for reproduction.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不会改写预训练范式，但若你关心模型发布后的低比特可用性，先看它是否真能稳定补 PTQ 尾差；重点看低比特和大模型表格。
recommendation.en: It won’t change pretraining priors, but if you care about deployable low-bit LLMs, check whether this reliably closes PTQ residual error; focus on the low-bit large-model tables.

paper.title: CubicQuant: Parametric Non-Uniform Codebooks for High-Throughput LLM Inference with 1-8-Bit Weights
paper.abstract: Weight quantization for large-language-model inference must balance adaptive reconstruction levels with representations regular enough for efficient GPU execution. Uniform integers constrain each group to a linear grid. Low-bit floating-point formats use a fixed exponent-mantissa structure, while learned codebooks gain flexibility at the cost of irregular decoding and additional metadata. summary.core_problem: LLM 权重量化需要在自适应重建电平与 GPU 友好的规整整数表示之间取得平衡。
summary.importance: 工程方法创新，提出一种参数化非均匀标量量化格式，覆盖 1-8 bit 并保持稠密整数码流。
summary.technical_approach: CubicQuant 用由两个形状参数和一个 scale 决定的单调三次曲线，把均匀整数码映射为非均匀重建电平；均匀整数量化是其特例；有效位宽为 B+64/G；推导了 Uniform/Gaussian/Laplace 下的 population distortion，并给出连续优化目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、baseline 或精度数字，需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM weight quantization must balance adaptive reconstruction levels with GPU-friendly regular integer representations.
summary_en.importance: Engineering method: a parametric non-uniform scalar format covering 1-8 bits while preserving a dense integer code stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: CubicQuant uses a monotonic cubic curve (two shape params + one scale) mapping uniform integer codes to non-uniform levels; uniform integer quantization is a special case; effective width B+64/G; derives population distortion under Uniform/Gaussian/Laplace and a continuous optimization objective.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract gives no concrete model sizes, baselines, or accuracy numbers; see full text.

recommendation.zh: 思路介于 uniform 与 learned codebook 之间，三次曲线参数化得很省 metadata；摘要无实验数字，先看 §4 表格再判断是否值得跟进。
recommendation.en: A middle ground between uniform and learned codebooks with minimal metadata; no numbers in abstract—check §4 tables before investing.

paper.title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding

A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. summary.core_problem: 边缘设备LLM推理中，MoE与推测解码结合存在不兼容问题，FFN层的外部内存访问（EMA）是主要性能瓶颈
summary.importance: 系统/工程创新，提出软硬件协同的LLM加速器方案，解决MoE与推测解码的兼容问题，降低边缘LLM推理的内存访问开销
summary.technical_approach: 提出EdgeXpert软硬件协同加速器：预填充阶段将逐token独立路由重构为prompt级专家复用，用轻量编码器识别重要token构建共享专家集，降低非重要token的专家预算以减少EMA；解码阶段采用深度感知专家策略（摘要截断）
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验设置、模型规模、基线与效果数据
summary.authors_note: 未披露机构信息，Hoi-Jun Yoo为低功耗AI加速器领域知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Combining Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and speculative decoding for on-device LLM inference faces incompatibility issues, with external memory access (EMA) in FFN layers being the primary bottleneck
summary_en.importance: System/engineering innovation: a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator is proposed to resolve the incompatibility between MoE and speculative decoding, reducing memory access overhead for edge LLM inference
summary_en.technical_approach: EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed accelerator, reformulates per-token routing as prompt-level expert reuse in the prefill stage: a lightweight encoder identifies important tokens to build a shared expert set, and less important tokens are routed with a reduced expert budget to lower EMA; depth-aware expert policy is used in the decode stage (abstract truncated)

summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations not disclosed; Hoi-Jun Yoo is a well-known scholar in low-power AI accelerators

recommendation.en: Software-hardware co-design for edge LLM inference; MoE routing optimization is hardware-focused, no deep reading needed for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: QEvict: Recoverable Quantized KV Eviction for Attention-Drift-Robust Long-Context Decoding

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存驱逐策略采用不可逆的二元保留/删除决策，隐含“被驱逐token后续不会再重要”的假设，无法应对解码过程中token重要性的漂移
summary.importance: 方法创新+新观察，首次明确提出解码过程中的注意力漂移现象，给出可恢复的量化KV驱逐方案，提升长上下文解码的鲁棒性
summary.technical_approach: 提出QEvict三级KV缓存管理方案，用可恢复驱逐替代二元保留/删除：高置信度窗口保留全精度缓存，中置信度token用量化形式保留（可恢复），低置信度token丢弃；引入Future Missed Mass和Global LIR两个诊断指标衡量注意力漂移与历史区域重激活情况
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验设置、模型规模、基线与效果数据
summary.authors_note: 机构为印度理工学院德里分校Yardi人工智能学院，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache eviction policies use irreversible binary retain-or-delete decisions, implicitly assuming evicted tokens will not be important later, which fails to handle importance drift during decoding
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation + new observation: attention drift during decoding is explicitly identified for the first time, and a recoverable quantized KV eviction scheme is proposed to improve robustness of long-context decoding
summary_en.technical_approach: QEvict, a three-tier KV cache management scheme, replaces binary eviction with recoverable eviction: high-confidence windows are kept in full precision, medium-confidence tokens are retained in quantized form (recoverable), and low-confidence tokens are discarded; two diagnostics, Future Missed Mass and Global LIR, are introduced to measure attention drift and reactivation of historically inactive regions
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup, model scale, baselines, and results are not disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi; no well-known authors

recommendation.zh: 注意力漂移的观察有一定启发，可关注诊断指标部分，驱逐方法是推理侧工程，无需深读
recommendation.en: Attention drift observation is mildly insightful; focus on diagnostic metrics, the eviction method is inference-side engineering.

institutions: Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi

paper.title: GyRot: Leveraging Hidden Synergy between Rotation and Fine-grained Group Quantization for Low-bit LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Low-bit quantization is essential for efficient LLM inference, and both rotation and fine-grained group quantization have shown individual promise. However, their combination often leads to accuracy degradation or hardware overhead due to a mismatch between the global nature of rotation and the localized behavior of group scaling. We propose GyRot, a quantization framework and hardware accelerator that bridges this gap through algorithm-hardware co-design. GyRot introduces Coarse Rotation, Fine

summary.core_problem: 解决旋转量化与细粒度分组量化结合时，因全局旋转特性与局部分组缩放不匹配导致的精度下降或硬件开销过高问题，用于低比特LLM推理。
summary.importance: 工程创新（算法-硬件协同设计），填补了旋转与分组量化高效融合的技术空白，为低比特LLM推理提供了兼顾精度与硬件效率的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 原创GyRot框架：1）提出粗旋转-细分组（CoRFiG）与谐波对齐置换（HAP），实现旋转与分组量化的协同，放松缩放因子精度要求；2）重构非对称量化，引入零点 rounding 策略实现全整数反量化；3）配套INT4张量处理单元架构的硬件加速器。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA系列模型上实现当前最优的4-bit量化精度；硬件基于INT4张量PE架构实现，其余性能指标因摘要截断未完全披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses accuracy degradation and hardware overhead caused by the mismatch between global rotation properties and localized group scaling when combining rotation-based and fine-grained group quantization for low-bit LLM inference.
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation via algorithm-hardware co-design, filling the gap of efficient fusion between rotation and group quantization, providing a solution balancing accuracy and hardware efficiency for low-bit LLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the GyRot framework: 1) Coarse Rotation Fine Grouping (CoRFiG) and Harmonic-Aligned Permutation (HAP) to enable cooperative integration of rotation and group quantization, relaxing scaling factor precision requirements; 2) Reformulates asymmetric quantization with a zero-point rounding strategy for fully integer dequantization; 3) Co-designs a hardware accelerator based on INT4 tensor PE architecture.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves state-of-the-art 4-bit quantization accuracy across LLaMA-family models; hardware is implemented on an INT4 tensor PE architecture, remaining performance metrics are truncated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 推理侧量化-硬件协同的实用工作，旋转-分组匹配思路可作量化友好预训练的弱参考，仅看摘要与方法核心即可。
recommendation.en: Practical inference-side quantization-hardware co-design; the rotation-group matching idea serves as weak reference for quantization-aware pretraining, check abstract and core method only.

paper.title: LightRot: A Light-Weighted Rotation Scheme and Architecture for Accurate Low-Bit Large Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various domains, the challenge of achieving energy-efficient and accurate inference becomes increasingly critical. This work presents LightRot, a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated hardware accelerator designed for low-bit LLM inference. The proposed architecture integrates Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) algorithms with a hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-bas

summary.core_problem: 解决低比特LLM推理中旋转操作能量开销高、现有方案仅适配小模型或基础语言建模任务的问题，实现大模型的高精度、高能效低比特推理。
summary.importance: 工程创新（算法-硬件协同设计），提出轻量旋转方案与专用加速器，首次将低比特旋转量化方案适配到LLaMA2-13B、LLaMA3-8B等先进大模型。
summary.technical_approach: 原创LightRot方案：1）算法侧提出分组局部旋转（GLR）与离群方向对齐（ODA），降低旋转计算开销并提升量化精度；2）硬件侧采用基于分层快速哈达玛变换（FHT）的旋转单元，28nm CMOS工艺流片实现。
summary.experiments: 在28nm CMOS工艺下实现4-bit推理峰值能效27.4 TOPS/W，优于此前同类型最优设计；在LLaMA2-13B、LLaMA3-8B上验证，无需更高精度推理辅助即可保持精度。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses high energy overhead of rotation operations in low-bit LLM inference and the limitation that prior schemes only adapt to small models or basic language modeling tasks, enabling high-accuracy and energy-efficient low-bit inference for large LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation via algorithm-hardware co-design, proposes a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated accelerator, first adapting low-bit rotation quantization to advanced large models like LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the LightRot framework: 1) Algorithm-side Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) to reduce rotation compute overhead and improve quantization accuracy; 2) Hardware-side hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-based rotation unit, implemented in 28nm CMOS process.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves a peak energy efficiency of 27.4 TOPS/W for 4-bit inference in 28nm CMOS, outperforming prior state-of-the-art designs; validated on LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B without requiring higher-precision inference assistance.

recommendation.zh: 同团队GyRot的姊妹篇，核心是旋转的硬件轻量化，对预训练无直接方法论价值，仅作量化部署的行业参考。
recommendation.en: Sister work to the team's prior GyRot; focuses on hardware-level rotation lightweighting, no direct pretraining methodological value, only serves as a deployment reference.

paper.title: From Tokens to Watt-hours: Analytical Energy Estimation for LLM Inference on Modern GPUs
paper.abstract: The operational energy consumption of large language model (LLM) inference is becoming an increasingly important component of the environmental footprint of deployed AI systems. However, direct measurement of inference energy often requires hardware telemetry, power instrumentation, or infrastructure-specific monitoring, limiting its applicability in comparative studies, early-stage system design, and sustainability reporting. This report presents an analytically structured, empirically calibrat

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理能耗直接测量依赖硬件遥测或专用监控，限制了早期系统设计、对比研究和可持续报告的应用场景，需无需直接测量的GPU级推理能耗估算方法。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出分析式结合经验校准的LLM推理能耗估算框架，无需硬件监控即可快速评估能效，为架构选型、部署成本核算和可持续性报告提供实用工具。
summary.technical_approach: 原创分析框架，核心由三部分构成：1）基于Transformer参数规模的FLOP统计；2）经校准的内存流量系数；3）NVIDIA H100级硬件的FP16/BF16张量核计算与HBM数据移动的专用能耗系数；显式拆分prefill与decode阶段，支持token级能耗拆分估算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置（如测试模型参数量、数据集、对比Baseline）及估算精度的量化结果，仅说明方法针对NVIDIA H100类加速器设计，支持分阶段token级能耗估算。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct measurement of LLM inference energy relies on hardware telemetry or dedicated monitoring, limiting applicability in early-stage system design, comparative studies, and sustainability reporting; a GPU-level estimation method without runtime measurement is needed.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: an analytically structured, empirically calibrated framework for LLM inference energy estimation that eliminates hardware monitoring dependency, providing a practical tool for architecture selection, deployment cost accounting, and sustainability reporting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Original analytical framework combining three components: 1) parameter-scaled Transformer FLOP accounting; 2) calibrated memory-traffic coefficients; 3) hardware-specific energy coefficients for FP16/BF16 tensor core computation and HBM data movement on NVIDIA H100-class GPUs; explicitly splits prefill and autoregressive decode phases to enable token-level energy breakdown.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific experimental setups (e.g., model parameter sizes, test datasets, comparison baselines) or quantitative estimation accuracy results; it only states the method targets H100-class GPUs and supports phased token-level energy estimation.

recommendation.zh: 做架构选型或缩放成本核算时，可直接复用其prefill/decode分阶段能耗拆解公式，仅看§3的硬件系数表即可。
recommendation.en: For architecture selection or scaling cost accounting, reuse its prefill/decode phased energy breakdown formulas; only §3 hardware coefficient tables are needed.

paper.title: Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: The increasing deployment of large language models (LLMs) has magnified the computational and memory bottlenecks of autoregressive decoding, where low compute intensity and bandwidth-bound kernels dominate inference cost. Weight pruning offers a promising remedy,   but existing methods remain confined to either static pruning (SP), which permanently removes redundant weights but lacks adaptivity, or dynamic pruning (DP), which adapts to input sparsity but introduces runtime irregularity. This pa

summary.core_problem: 降低 LLM 自回归推理中的计算和显存带宽瓶颈，特别是解码阶段低算术强度、带宽受限 kernel 的成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LLM 推理系统和 GPU 稀疏执行工程。它把静态权重剪枝和输入自适应动态剪枝放到同一套 sparse-inference 框架里，试图同时获得离线稀疏化的稳定性和运行时跳过无效计算的适应性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPDP，将 unstructured static pruning 与 input-adaptive dynamic pruning 结合。系统侧设计 Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed 格式，并分别为 decode 和 prefill 配套两个 GPU kernel：CUDA-core spMspV kernel 用 HAD-SMBD 做细粒度运行时 activation skipping，Tensor-Core SpMM kernel 针对 prefill 的稀疏矩阵乘优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、稀疏率、延迟、吞吐、困惑度或精度保持数据。可确认的实验关注点应是 LLM GPU 推理中的 decode/prefill 分阶段性能，但需要正文验证实际 speedup 是否覆盖端到端 serving。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets compute and memory-bandwidth bottlenecks in autoregressive LLM inference, especially bandwidth-bound kernels during decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is an LLM inference-systems contribution. It combines static weight pruning with input-adaptive dynamic pruning in one sparse-inference framework, aiming to retain the stability of offline sparsification while exploiting runtime activation sparsity.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPDP integrates unstructured static pruning and dynamic pruning. It introduces a Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed format and two GPU kernels: a CUDA-core spMspV kernel with Hybrid Activation-aware Dynamic Shared-Memory Bitmap Decoding for fine-grained runtime activation skipping, and a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel optimized for prefill.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model families, sparsity levels, latency, throughput, perplexity, or accuracy-retention numbers. The relevant evaluation should be decode/prefill performance on GPUs, but the end-to-end serving gains need to be checked in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 kernel 设计和端到端延迟表；若收益主要停在 microbenchmark，对预训练侧价值有限。
recommendation.en: Read the kernel design and end-to-end latency tables; if the gains are mostly microbenchmarks, the pretraining-side signal is limited.

paper.title: Efficient Clustering with Provable Guardrails for LLM Inference at Scale
paper.abstract: Scaling LLM-based applications to millions of users is bottlenecked by the inference cost and latency of modern foundation models. A natural fix is to cluster the inputs and call the LLM only on cluster representatives, letting other members inherit the output -- but this is only safe if each member is measurably close to its representative. Existing clustering methods do not offer such per-sample quality control at scale: none jointly guarantee a minimal within-cluster similarity, exact matchin

summary.core_problem: 现有基于输入聚类复用LLM推理结果的成本优化方法，无法在千万级样本规模下同时保证类内相似度下限、分类属性精确匹配和可扩展性，存在输出不可靠风险。
summary.importance: LLM推理服务的工程创新，提出带可证明质量护栏的大规模聚类算法，解决了语义缓存类方案的质量不可控问题，可支撑大规模LLM服务的成本削减。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段聚类流程：第一阶段用Mini-batch K-Means生成初始簇；第二阶段在每个初始簇内通过等价于Johnson-Chvatal集覆盖启发式的方法贪心选择代表点，构造上严格保证类内嵌入相似度不低于阈值、分类属性完全匹配，时间复杂度为O(nd + n²d/K)，空间复杂度为O(nd + n²/K²)。
summary.experiments: 论文给出算法正确性证明和复杂度分析，验证其可扩展到千万级样本规模并严格满足预设护栏，摘要未披露具体端到端LLM服务的效果数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing input clustering methods for reusing LLM inference outputs cannot jointly guarantee minimal within-cluster similarity, exact categorical attribute matching and scalability to tens of millions of samples, leading to unreliable output reuse.
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation for LLM serving, proposing a large-scale clustering algorithm with provable quality guardrails to solve the quality control issue of semantic caching approaches, enabling cost reduction for web-scale LLM services.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage clustering: first generate initial clusters with Mini-batch K-Means; then greedily select representatives per cluster via a step equivalent to the Johnson-Chvatal Set Cover heuristic over embedding-space alpha-balls. The construction exactly enforces similarity thresholds and categorical attribute matches, with O(nd + n²d/K) time and O(nd + n²/K²) memory complexity.
summary_en.experiments: The paper provides formal correctness proofs and complexity analysis, verifying scalability to tens of millions of samples while satisfying pre-set guardrails; no end-to-end LLM serving performance numbers are disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 语义缓存方案的工程补全，无新建模洞见，做Serving的可参考思路，预训练研究员不用读正文。
recommendation.en: Engineering fix for semantic caching with no new modeling insights; serving teams may reference the approach, but pretrain researchers do not need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Decode-Time Grammars: Constrained LLM Generation over a Refinement Order of Grammar Fragments
paper.abstract: Large language models now write a growing share of the world's code, increasingly inside agents and serving systems that compile, execute, or dispatch generated code without line-by-line review. This works well for mainstream languages but remains brittle for low-resource programming surfaces such as domain-specific languages, custom library APIs, and command-line tools. Even under grammar-constrained decoding, a model can still produce references invalid in the current environment: a buffer nev

summary.core_problem: 解决语法约束解码下LLM仍会生成当前运行环境无效引用（未声明变量、不存在的API等）的问题，尤其针对低资源编程语言/DSL/自定义库场景。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出解码时动态语法约束范式，将运行时环境信息注入解码过程，提升代码生成的环境有效性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出decode-time grammars框架，从运行时环境Γ实例化语法片段，通过区域特定策略为每个生成位置选择对应语法片段，用收紧操作符将开放引用位置替换为Γ类型约束的槽位，候选集严格限定为当前环境可用的名称、字段、API等。
summary.experiments: 原文摘要截断，未给出具体实验设置与量化结果，仅提及方法可生成符合运行时环境约束的声明式代码。

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the problem that even under grammar-constrained decoding, LLMs still generate references invalid in the current runtime environment, especially for low-resource programming languages/DSLs/custom libraries.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a decode-time dynamic grammar constraint paradigm that injects runtime environment information into the decoding process to improve the environmental validity of generated code.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the decode-time grammars framework, which instantiates grammar fragments from the runtime environment Γ, selects the appropriate fragment for each generation position via a region-specific policy, and replaces open reference positions with Γ-typed slots with strictly limited candidate sets.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated, no detailed experimental setup or quantitative results provided; only mentions the method can generate declarative code compliant with runtime environment constraints.

recommendation.zh: 代码生成领域的约束解码增量改进，仅针对低资源DSL场景，与预训练方法论无关，了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental constrained decoding improvement for code generation targeting low-resource DSLs; irrelevant to pretraining methodology, only worth knowing the high-level idea.

paper.title: MXSens: Sensitivity-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: 4-bit quantization enables efficient LLM inference, but suffers from significant accuracy degradation due to outliers. Prior work addresses this problem via data rotation or mixed-precision integer quantization, but often relies on software-managed scaling and frequent dequantization, incurring substantial overhead. Microscaling formats, such as MXINT, eliminate these inefficiencies by encoding scales in hardware, yet remain incompatible with rotation-based methods. Our analysis reveals that out

summary.core_problem: 4-bit LLM 量化中离群值导致精度下降，而现有 MXINT 硬件微缩放格式与旋转类方法不兼容，混合精度又常引入软件缩放/反量化开销。
summary.importance: 给出一种无需训练、面向 MXINT 硬件格式的敏感度感知混合位宽量化方案，对部署侧有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 分析离群值严重程度跨层/跨列分布不均，提出 MXSens：按列与按层的量化敏感度，在 MXINT 块结构内为不同列分配 4/6/8 位尾数，无需训练、无需旋转。
summary.experiments: 在多类 LLM 上超过现有量化方法（摘要截断，具体模型与幅度未给出）；training-free。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Babak Falsafi、Martin Jaggi、Amir Yazdanbakhsh 等，来自 EPFL/CMU/Google DeepMind 相关背景（按作者所属机构常见归属，未在摘要中明确列出）。

summary_en.core_problem: 4-bit LLM quantization suffers from outliers; rotation-based methods are incompatible with hardware microscaling (MXINT) formats, while mixed-precision approaches incur software scaling/dequant overhead.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, sensitivity-guided mixed mantissa-bitwidth quantization tailored to MXINT's block structure, with practical deployment value.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that outlier severity and quantization sensitivity are uneven across layers and columns; MXSens assigns 4/6/8-bit mantissas per column/layer based on sensitivity, naturally fitting MXINT blocks without rotation or retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms prior quantization methods across a range of LLMs (abstract truncated; training-free).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Babak Falsafi, Martin Jaggi, and Amir Yazdanbakhsh.

recommendation.zh: 纯推理量化工作，对预训练无直接 insight；若做 MX 硬件部署可看 §3 的敏感度分布分析，否则跳过。
recommendation.en: Inference-only quantization; no direct pretraining insight. Read §3 sensitivity analysis only if you deploy on MX hardware.

paper.title: PolyQ: Codesigning End-to-End Quantization Framework for Scalable Edge CPU LLM Inference
paper.abstract: CPUs are the most universal target for on-device LLM inference, but existing low-bit quantization methods offer either coarse operating points or fine-grained mixed precision that is difficult to execute efficiently on CPUs. We present PolyQ, a CPU-oriented compiler/quantization co-design for activation-aware channel-wise bit allocation under a user-specified average-bit budget. PolyQ assigns per-channel bit-widths from $\{2,3,4,8,16\}$, then uses a compile-time model compiler to permute and clu

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM低比特量化方案存在两端脱节：粗粒度整层统一比特的方法无法灵活适配不同内存预算，细粒度逐通道混合精度的方法又难以在CPU上高效执行，缺少能在用户指定的任意平均比特预算下，同时兼顾精度和CPU执行效率的端侧CPU推理量化方案。
summary.importance: 通过量化与编译的共设计，解决了细粒度混合精度量化在CPU上落地的核心系统障碍，将比特预算的控制粒度从整层推进到逐通道，同时把所有布局变换开销移到编译期，消除了运行时额外开销。对端侧CPU部署场景有直接工程价值，但属于推理优化的系统类工作，对预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: PolyQ是面向CPU的量化-编译共设计框架，分三步实现：1）逐通道从CPU友好的{2,3,4,8,16}比特集合中分配位宽，以激活感知的通道显著性为权重做水填充，精确匹配用户指定的分数平均比特预算；2）编译期将不规则的逐通道位宽分配通过排列、聚类操作重组为比特同质的块，为每个块生成适配SIMD指令和查找表（LUT）的计算内核；3）跨算子传播兼容的排列规则，让相邻层的布局变换相互抵消，全程不需要运行时数据重排。
summary.experiments: 在3比特平均预算下，模型困惑度比现有方法低2.4%–32.1%；编译期量子匹配后，实际平均比特与目标值的偏差不超过0.045比特；激活重排带来的数据流量比现有布局策略最多降低70.8%；端到端推理延迟与经过优化的LUT后端差距在5.8%以内，每token的额外能耗开销小于2%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看引言提出的三个核心落地障碍、方法部分的共设计思路，以及实验中的精度-延迟-开销权衡结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。从事端侧CPU部署的工程师可以进一步深入看编译期排列传播和内核生成的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM low-bit quantization methods face a mismatch between granularity and deployability: coarse per-layer uniform bit-width schemes cannot flexibly adapt to varying memory budgets, while fine-grained per-channel mixed precision schemes cannot execute efficiently on CPUs. No end-to-end quantization solution for edge CPU inference supports arbitrary user-specified average bit budgets while balancing both accuracy and CPU execution efficiency.
summary_en.importance: This work resolves core system barriers to deploying fine-grained mixed-precision quantization on CPUs via quantization-compiler co-design, pushing bit budget control granularity from per-layer to per-channel while moving all layout transformation overhead to compile time to eliminate runtime costs. It delivers direct engineering value for edge CPU deployment scenarios, but offers limited direct insight for pretraining research as an inference optimization system work.
