summary.core_problem: NVFP4是近期提出的硬件支持的FP4格式，现有缩放初始化方法主要依赖AbsMax初始化，与最优解之间存在明显差距。
summary.importance: 提出ScaleSweep——简单高效的NVFP4块尺度优化方法，并提供了理论分析和扫描范围边界，大幅减少扫描空间同时保留最优候选。
summary.technical_approach: ScaleSweep在可行的块尺度候选范围内扫描，选择使目标函数最小的候选；理论推导了MSE和WMSE下所需扫描范围的上下界，从而大幅减少扫描空间而不丢失最优解；相比基线量化算子增加的开销可忽略不计。
summary.experiments: 在Llama和Qwen模型上实验，验证了ScaleSweep在保持最低开销的同时，相比AbsMax初始化在NVFP4量化精度上取得了明显改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者Li Lin和Xiaojun Wan，无法从论文信息确认机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: NVFP4 is a recently introduced hardware-supported FP4 format for 4-bit quantization; existing scale initialization methods still rely primarily on AbsMax initialization, leaving a noticeable gap to the optimal solution.
summary_en.importance: Presents ScaleSweep, a simple and efficient NVFP4 block scale optimization method with theoretical analysis and sweep range bounds that substantially reduce the search space while preserving optimal candidates with negligible overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScaleSweep sweeps over feasible block scale candidates and selects the one minimizing a target objective; provides theoretical derivation of upper and lower bounds for the required sweep range under MSE and WMSE, drastically reducing search space without losing optimal solutions; overhead is negligible compared with baseline quantization operators.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on Llama and Qwen models validate that ScaleSweep achieves significant improvements in NVFP4 quantization accuracy over AbsMax initialization while maintaining minimal overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are Li Lin and Xiaojun Wan; institutional affiliations not identifiable from paper information.

recommendation.zh: NVFP4量化的实用改进，理论推导有一定参考价值。关注量化的研究员值得看推导部分。
recommendation.en: Practical improvement for NVFP4 quantization with useful theoretical derivations; researchers focused on quantization should check the derivation section.

paper.title: Cross-Lingual Token Arbitrage: Optimizing Code Agent Context Windows via Local LLM Preprocessing
paper.abstract: AI-assisted coding agents are bottlenecked by input-token cost. Two pathologies of raw human input drive much of this overhead: tokenization inefficiency for non-English text and structural entropy in conversational prompts. Existing approaches act reactively by compressing already-bloated contexts or intervening after failures occur.   We introduce a pre-flight, edge-side prompt-rewriting middleware that operates between the developer and the cloud agent. A local Llama 3.2 (3B) model performs c

summary.core_problem: 代码Agent的输入token成本瓶颈源于两个问题：非英语文本的tokenization低效和对话prompt的结构熵。现有方法都是被动地压缩已膨胀的上下文或在失败后干预。
summary.importance: 提出预飞行边缘端prompt重写中间件，在开发者和云端Agent之间进行跨语言token优化，属于coding agent效率方向的方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 本地Llama 3.2 3B模型执行三项操作：跨语言翻译为英语、结构化重写为紧凑任务导向格式、regex验证的重写回退机制确保优化后的prompt不大于原文。
summary.experiments: 在OMH-Polyglot多语言代码benchmark（土耳其语、阿拉伯语、中文和语码混合）上评估，三个商业LLM后端中prompt token减少34-47%，总token减少达18.8%，同时保持或提升任务性能。
summary.authors_note: Mehmet Utku Colak，伊斯坦布尔技术大学。

summary_en.core_problem: Input token cost bottleneck for coding agents stems from two pathologies: tokenization inefficiency for non-English text and structural entropy in conversational prompts. Existing approaches reactively compress already-bloated contexts or intervene after failures.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a pre-flight edge-side prompt-rewriting middleware for cross-lingual token optimization between developer and cloud agent—a methodological innovation in coding agent efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: A local Llama 3.2 3B model performs three operations: cross-lingual translation into English, structural rewriting into compact task-oriented format, regex-validated rewrite-with-fallback ensuring optimized prompts are never larger than originals.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on OMH-Polyglot multilingual coding benchmark (Turkish, Arabic, Chinese, code-switched). Across three commercial LLM backends: prompt tokens reduced 34-47%, total tokens up to 18.8% while preserving or improving task performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Mehmet Utku Colak, Istanbul Technical University.

recommendation.zh: 跨语言token效率差异是tokenizer设计中的真实痛点，这篇用推理时小模型重写来解决。看实验结果即可，方法无新意。
recommendation.en: Cross-lingual token efficiency disparity is a real pain point in tokenizer design. This paper solves it at inference time with a small model. Check experiment results only; method is unsurprising.

paper.title: CacheProbe: Auditing Prompt Cache Isolation in Gateway APIs
paper.abstract: Over the past year, prompt caching in Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly more popular across inference APIs. Prompt caching helps save precious compute resources and speeds up response times by reusing parts of the KV cache of a specific prompt for another request. However, many implementations of prompt caching are not secure against timing attacks or even basic metadata disclosure. Gu et al. (ICML 2025) develop a method to audit prompt caching in LLMs. This paper investigates

summary.core_problem: 审计LLM推理API网关层的提示缓存隔离机制是否存在安全漏洞，是否会绕过提供商层面的缓存隔离导致跨用户数据泄露
summary.importance: 安全问题分析，首次针对API网关架构的提示缓存隔离性开展审计，补充现有LLM缓存安全研究的空白
summary.technical_approach: 基于已有提示缓存审计方法，针对OpenRouter网关架构设计测试用例，验证共享组织凭证下是否存在跨用户全局缓存共享问题
summary.experiments: 以OpenRouter API为测试对象，对比提供商层面单账号/单组织缓存隔离机制与网关路由后的实际缓存行为，未公开最终定量漏洞验证结果
summary.authors_note: 作者Ryan Fahey，未公开所属机构背景

summary_en.core_problem: Audit whether prompt cache isolation vulnerabilities exist in LLM inference API gateway architectures that bypass provider-level cache isolation guarantees
summary_en.importance: Security issue analysis, first audit of prompt cache isolation in API gateway architectures, filling the gap in existing LLM cache security research
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds on existing prompt cache auditing methods, designs test cases for the OpenRouter gateway architecture to verify cross-user global cache sharing under shared organizational credentials
summary_en.experiments: Tests on OpenRouter API, compares provider-level per-account/per-organization cache isolation mechanisms with actual cache behavior after gateway routing; no final quantitative vulnerability verification results disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Author Ryan Fahey, no affiliated institution background available

recommendation.zh: 推理缓存安全的细分问题，对预训练研究员无直接启发，仅做缓存架构设计的安全参考
recommendation.en: A niche inference cache security issue with no direct insight for pretraining researchers, only as a security reference for cache architecture design

paper.title: InfoQuant: Shaping Activation Distributions for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear nu

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决低比特 LLM 激活量化中的一个具体问题：激活分布不只存在 outlier，还常常与低比特均匀量化器的离散级别不匹配。
summary.importance: 它属于推理效率方向，对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对大模型部署和训练后压缩有实际参考价值。论文的主要启发是把激活变换从“压 outlier”或“最小化 MSE”改写为“面向量化器设计分布”。这个角度更清楚地解释了为什么某些方法看起来让数值更平滑，却仍然在 4-bit activation quantization 下损失明显：量化范围仍然过宽，或者多数值挤在均值附近的少数几个离散 level 上。
summary.technical_approach: InfoQuant 是一种 train-free PTQ 方法，核心是学习正交变换来重塑激活分布。论文从信息论角度分析 round-to-nearest 均匀量化的误差来源，认为量化友好的激活分布应同时满足两个条件：数值范围更小；在该范围内有更高的归一化离散度。前者避免少数极端值拉大量化步长，后者避免大量普通值坍缩到均值附近的少数 level。方法上，InfoQuant 引入 Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation，用激活侧 peak suppression 目标降低范围并提高分散度；再用 adaptive outlier-token selection 提高校准优化稳定性；最后学习 activation clipping 参数，细化变换后的量化范围。它主要处理 activation，也可与常规 weight quantization pipeline 组合。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 W4A4KV4 设置，即权重、激活和 KV cache 都做 4-bit 量化。覆盖 LLaMA-2 7B、13B、70B，以及 LLaMA-3 8B、70B。结果显示这些模型平均保留约 97% 的原始性能。另一个工程结果是，70B 模型可在 24GB GPU 显存下完成量化。实验重点不是单个任务分数，而是证明“缩小范围 + 增大范围内分散度”的分布目标，比只看 outlier 抑制或 MSE 重构更贴近低比特激活量化的真实困难。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–25 分钟。先看 Motivation 中对均匀量化误差的分析，尤其是为什么 bell-shaped activation 加少量 outlier 会导致 4-bit 下离散 level 利用率很差。然后看 InfoQuant 的 PSOT 目标、outlier-token selection 和 clipping 学习。实验部分重点看 W4A4KV4、70B 校准显存，以及与 SmoothQuant、QuaRot、SpinQuant 这类 activation transformation 方法的差异。对做预训练的人，主要可借鉴它对 activation 分布形态的诊断，而不是具体 PTQ recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in low-bit LLM quantization: activation difficulty is not only caused by outliers, but also by a poor match between the activation distribution and the discrete levels of a low-bit uniform quantizer.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is useful for deployment and post-training compression. Its main value is the distribution-design view of activation transformation. Instead of only suppressing outliers or minimizing reconstruction MSE, it asks what distribution a 4-bit uniform quantizer can preserve well. This explains why some transformations can make activations look smoother while still causing large degradation: the quantization range may remain too wide, or most values may collapse into only a few levels near the mean.
summary_en.technical_approach: InfoQuant is a train-free PTQ method that learns orthogonal transformations to reshape activation distributions. The paper analyzes round-to-nearest uniform quantization from an information-theoretic angle and identifies two desirable properties: a smaller numerical range and higher normalized dispersion within that range. The first property prevents rare extremes from inflating the quantization step size; the second prevents dense central values from collapsing into too few quantization bins. The main component is Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation, which optimizes an activation-side objective to reduce peaks while increasing dispersion. The method also uses adaptive outlier-token selection for more stable calibration and learns activation clipping parameters after distribution shaping. It focuses on activation optimization and remains compatible with standard weight-quantization pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: The reported setting is W4A4KV4, where weights, activations, and KV cache are all quantized to 4 bits. Experiments include LLaMA-2 7B, 13B, and 70B, as well as LLaMA-3 8B and 70B. The models retain about 97% of their original performance on average. The paper also reports that a 70B model can be quantized with only 24GB of GPU memory. The key empirical point is that explicitly shaping the activation distribution toward smaller range and better within-range dispersion is more aligned with low-bit activation quantization than objectives based only on outlier suppression or MSE reconstruction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–25 minutes. Start with the motivation section on uniform quantization error, especially the discussion of bell-shaped activations with a small number of outliers. Then read the PSOT objective, adaptive outlier-token selection, and learned clipping components. In the experiments, focus on W4A4KV4 results, the 70B memory requirement, and comparisons with activation-transformation methods such as SmoothQuant, QuaRot, and SpinQuant. For pretraining researchers, the most transferable part is the diagnosis of activation distribution geometry, not the exact PTQ recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“量化友好分布=小 range + 足够 dispersion”这个判断值得记；先看分析部分，若实验只赢一点也不奇怪。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that quantization-friendly activations need both small range and enough dispersion is worth keeping; read the analysis first, and do not overreact if the empirical gains are modest.

paper.title: Llamas on the Web: Memory-Efficient, Performance-Portable, and Multi-Precision LLM Inference with WebGPU
paper.abstract: Running language models in the browser presents a unique opportunity to build efficient, private, and portable AI applications, but requires contending with constrained memory availability and heterogeneous hardware targets. To realize this opportunity, we present Llamas on the Web (LlamaWeb), a WebGPU backend for llama$.$cpp that enables memory-efficient and performance-portable LLM inference across a wide range of model weight formats in the browser. Our design significantly reduces memory ove

summary.core_problem: 现有浏览器端WebGPU LLM推理框架存在动态内存分配效率低、跨硬件性能不可移植、量化格式支持有限的问题，导致浏览器端运行LLM容易出现运行卡顿、标签页崩溃，且硬件适配性差。
summary.importance: 补充了端侧LLM部署生态的工具链，其内存优化和量化适配的设计思路可为边缘推理后端开发提供参考，也为预训练模型的端侧落地可行性验证提供了统一工具。
summary.technical_approach: 作为llama.cpp的WebGPU后端，核心设计有三点：1）静态内存规划，启动时一次性分配所有推理所需内存（包括FlashAttention中间缓存、核参数固定槽位区），异步流式加载权重避免冗余数据拷贝；2）模板化可微调核库，支持按设备定制矩阵乘tile尺寸，可按需启用子组矩阵指令，不支持时自动回退通用实现，同时优化GPU核提交分组逻辑减少CPU-GPU同步开销；3）原生实现多种量化格式的高性能核，支持快速扩展新量化格式。
summary.experiments: 在Chrome和Safari浏览器下，峰值内存占用比现有WebGPU推理框架平均低29-33%；在8家厂商的16款设备（含移动端）上测试10款模型，解码阶段性能比WebLLM、Transformers.js平均高54-69%，部分场景性能超过原生后端，仅预填充（Prefill）阶段性能比对比框架低21-51%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3-4章的内存和核设计部分，第5-6章的跨设备性能和内存对比数据，预计阅读时间15分钟，无需深入理解shader实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing browser-based WebGPU LLM inference frameworks suffer from dynamic memory allocation inefficiencies, lack of performance portability across heterogeneous hardware, and limited quantization format support, leading to runtime slowdowns, tab crashes, and poor hardware compatibility.
summary_en.importance: Complements the edge LLM deployment ecosystem. Its memory optimization and quantization adaptation designs provide references for edge inference backend development, and offer a unified tool for validating the edge deployability of pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: As a WebGPU backend for llama.cpp, it has three core designs: 1) Static memory planning that allocates all required inference memory (including FlashAttention intermediate buffers and fixed kernel parameter slots) at startup, with asynchronous weight streaming to avoid redundant data copies; 2) Templated tunable kernel library that supports device-specific matrix multiplication tile sizing, optional subgroup matrix instructions with automatic fallback to portable implementations, and optimized kernel submission grouping to reduce CPU-GPU synchronization overhead; 3) Native high-performance kernels for multiple quantization formats, with support for fast extension to new formats.
summary_en.experiments: Peak memory usage is 29-33% lower on average than existing WebGPU frameworks across Chrome and Safari. Evaluated on 10 models across 16 devices from 8 vendors (including mobile devices), decode phase throughput is 54-69% higher on average than WebLLM and Transformers.js, outperforming native backends in some scenarios. Prefill phase throughput is 21-51% lower than baseline frameworks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Sections 3-4 for memory and kernel design, Sections 5-6 for cross-device performance and memory comparison data. Estimated reading time 15 minutes, no need to dive into shader implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 微软和 UCSC 合作的 WebGPU 推理后端，对关注端侧部署和量化支持的系统研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A WebGPU inference backend by Microsoft and UCSC, valuable for systems researchers focused on edge deployment and quantization support.

paper.title: Multi-Scale Dequant: Eliminating Dequantization Bottleneck via Activation Decomposition for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Quantization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) inference, yet the dequantization step-converting low-bit weights back to high-precision for matrix multiplication has become a critical bottleneck on modern AI accelerators. On architectures with decoupled compute units (e.g., Ascend NPUs), dequantization operations can consume more cycles than the matrix multiplication itself, leaving the high-throughput tensor cores underutilized. This paper presents Multi-Scale Dequant (MSD),

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决量化推理中的 dequantization 瓶颈。常见 W8A16 或 W4A16 路线把权重量化存储，但计算前要把低比特权重反量化到 BF16/FP16，再与高精度 activation 做 GEMM。在 NVIDIA Hopper、Ascend 910B 这类硬件上，反量化可能比矩阵乘本身更卡，导致 Tensor Core 或 Cube Core 等矩阵单元等待标量/向量单元。
summary.importance: 这属于 efficient 类工作，对基座研究的价值在于推理成本模型。它提醒量化收益不只由 bit 数决定，还受 dequant 路径、内存往返、硬件计算单元分工影响。对于长上下文 decode、KV cache 量化、服务端 batch 调度，这类瓶颈会直接决定实际吞吐。方法本身偏系统与数值表示，不是预训练方法，但对训练后模型如何被部署、以及预训练时是否要考虑硬件友好的数值格式有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: Multi-Scale Dequant 的核心选择是反过来处理 activation。传统路线把 INT8/INT4 权重提升到 BF16；MSD 保持权重为低精度，把 BF16 activation 分解成多个低精度分量，例如两个 INT8 分量及其缩放系数。随后执行多次 INT8×INT8 GEMM，再对输出按缩放系数加权重构。这样 GEMM 主路径里不再需要权重反量化，矩阵乘可以直接走低精度 tensor/cube 单元。它与把权重分解成二值或低比特分量的路线不同，MSD 分解 activation 侧，更适合 activation 自然以高精度到达、权重已经低精度常驻的推理场景。文中还把思路扩展到权重和 KV 的 dequantization-free 路径，并给出 INT8 与 MXFP4 设置下的误差界和延迟模型。
summary.experiments: 实验主要是数值模拟和算子级验证，而不是完整 LLM 端到端评测。文中指出 DeepSeek FlashMLA FP8 kernel 中，dequant path 约消耗 50 个 clock cycles per KV token，而 64 个 query heads 的 MMA 只需约 34 cycles，说明瓶颈确实在反量化路径。理论上，两次 INT8 pass 可得到接近 16 bit 的有效精度，W8A16 误差界为 M/64516；两次 MXFP4 pass 可得到约 6.6 bit 有效精度，每个 block 的误差界为 α/64，高于单次 MXFP8 的 5.24 bit。数值验证显示，在 GEMM 和 Flash Attention 场景中，MSD 相比反量化 baseline 没有降低精度，部分设置下 L2 error 更低。需要注意，缺少完整模型 perplexity、下游任务精度和线上吞吐的系统闭环结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 中对 dequantization bottleneck 的硬件拆解，重点看 Ascend Vector/Cube 分工和 NVIDIA kernel profile 的例子。方法部分看 activation decomposition 的公式，以及为什么多次低精度 GEMM 比一次混合精度 GEMM 更适合这类硬件。理论部分看误差界和 latency model，实验部分确认它目前主要是数值与算子层面验证。预计 25 到 35 分钟。若只关心 LLM 推理工程，可以直接看瓶颈分析、延迟模型和 Flash Attention/KV 相关实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the dequantization bottleneck in quantized LLM inference. Standard W8A16 or W4A16 inference stores weights in low precision but dequantizes them back to BF16 or FP16 before matrix multiplication. On hardware such as NVIDIA Hopper GPUs and Huawei Ascend 910B NPUs, this conversion and scaling path can dominate latency, leaving tensor or cube matrix units underutilized.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, but it is useful for foundation-model researchers because it refines the cost model of quantization. Lower bit-width does not automatically translate into higher throughput. The dequantization path, extra HBM traffic, and the division of labor between vector units and matrix units can dominate decode latency. The implications are relevant to long-context serving, KV-cache quantization, and hardware-aware choices of numerical formats.
summary_en.technical_approach: Multi-Scale Dequant changes which side gets transformed. Instead of lifting INT8 or INT4 weights back to BF16, it keeps weights in low precision and decomposes BF16 activations into multiple low-precision components with scaling coefficients. The system then runs several uniform low-precision GEMMs, such as INT8-by-INT8, and reconstructs the high-precision result by scaled accumulation. This removes weight and KV dequantization from the GEMM critical path. The design differs from methods that decompose weights into binary or low-bit components: MSD decomposes the activation side, which is natural when activations arrive in high precision while weights are already stored in low precision. The paper also provides error bounds and latency models for INT8 and MXFP4 configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The validation is mainly numerical and kernel-level rather than full end-to-end LLM evaluation. The paper reports that in a DeepSeek FlashMLA FP8 kernel, the dequantization path takes about 50 clock cycles per KV token, while the MMA work for 64 query heads takes about 34 cycles, making the kernel dequantization-bound. The analysis claims roughly 16 effective bits from two INT8 passes for W8A16, with an error bound of M/64516, and roughly 6.6 effective bits from two MXFP4 passes for W4A16, with a per-block bound of α/64, compared with 5.24 bits for a single MXFP8 pass. Numerical simulations for GEMM and Flash Attention show no accuracy degradation relative to dequantization baselines, and in some settings lower L2 error. A limitation is the lack of complete model-level perplexity, downstream accuracy, and production throughput results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the hardware bottleneck analysis, especially the Ascend Vector/Cube discussion and the NVIDIA kernel profiling example. Read the method section for the activation decomposition formula and the reason multiple uniform low-precision GEMMs can beat a mixed-precision path with dequantization. The theory section is worth reading for the error and latency models. The experiments should be read as numerical and operator-level evidence. Estimated reading time: 25 to 35 minutes. If the goal is LLM serving, focus on the bottleneck analysis, latency model, and Flash Attention or KV-cache parts.

recommendation.zh: 只看执行路径图和 kernel 假设；若 dequant 真在关键路径，activation decomposition 是值得复现的系统 trick。
recommendation.en: Read the execution-path diagram and kernel assumptions; if dequant is truly on the critical path, activation decomposition is a replication-worthy systems trick.

paper.title: EnergyLens: Predictive Energy-Aware Exploration for Multi-GPU LLM Inference Optimization
paper.abstract: We present EnergyLens, an end-to-end framework for energy-aware large language model (LLM) inference optimization. As LLMs scale, predicting and reducing their energy footprint has become critical for sustainability and datacenter operations, yet existing approaches either require production-level code and expensive profiling or fail to accurately capture multi-GPU energy behavior. As a result, practitioners lack tools for deciding which optimizations to prioritize and for selecting among existi

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理能耗评估方法存在明显局限：直接 profiling 需要GPU资源和大量工程实现成本，TDP等粗粒度方法会高估解码阶段能耗最高达60%，LLMCO2不支持算子融合与MoE架构，内核级预测器无法捕捉多GPU并行、计算通信重叠等分布式部署的核心能耗特征，导致从业者无法高效探索推理优化的能耗-延迟权衡空间。
summary.importance: 为LLM推理优化阶段的能耗评估提供了轻量级工具，不需要实际部署或GPU访问即可快速对比不同并行策略、融合方案、重叠设置的能耗表现，可降低部署前的优化探索成本，对数据中心级别的LLM部署能效规划有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于einsum的接口，开发者仅需几行代码即可定义LLM的架构、算子融合、并行策略和计算通信重叠设置；框架解析配置后提取GEMM维度、计算强度和通信内核信息，结合经验驱动的通信能耗模型、考虑负载不平衡的MoE建模，以及计算通信重叠的聚合逻辑，输出端到端的能耗拆解和能耗-延迟帕累托前沿。
summary.experiments: 在Llama3-70B和Qwen3-MoE上验证，多GPU能耗预测的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为9.25%-13.19%，计算通信重叠场景的MAPE为12.97%，该误差范围足够支撑筛选出最优部署配置；对比测试中，遍历Llama3-70B预填充阶段的2种融合设置、7种批量大小和32种输入长度，传统 profiling 需8卡服务器运行12小时加大量工程工作，EnergyLens仅需15分钟即可生成结果和可视化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章的分布式能耗建模栈设计，包括MoE负载不平衡建模和计算通信重叠的聚合逻辑；附录的误差来源分析可帮助理解模型的适用边界，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference energy evaluation methods have notable limitations: direct profiling requires GPU resources and substantial engineering implementation costs, coarse-grained methods like TDP overestimate decode phase energy by up to 60%, LLMCO2 does not support operator fusion or MoE architectures, and kernel-level predictors fail to capture core energy characteristics of distributed deployment such as multi-GPU parallelism and compute-communication overlap, leaving practitioners unable to efficiently explore the energy-latency trade-off space of inference optimizations.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight tool for energy evaluation during LLM inference optimization, enabling quick comparison of the energy performance of different parallel strategies, fusion schemes, and overlap settings without actual deployment or GPU access. It can reduce the cost of optimization exploration before deployment and has practical reference value for energy efficiency planning of LLM deployment at the data center level.
summary_en.technical_approach: An einsum-based interface is proposed, where developers only need a few lines of code to define the LLM architecture, operator fusion, parallel strategies, and compute-communication overlap settings. After parsing the configuration, the framework extracts GEMM dimensions, arithmetic intensity, and communication kernel information, combines empirically driven communication energy modeling, load-imbalance-aware MoE modeling, and aggregation logic for compute-communication overlap, and outputs end-to-end energy breakdowns and energy-latency Pareto fronts.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Llama3-70B and Qwen3-MoE, the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) for multi-GPU energy prediction is 9.25%-13.19%, and the MAPE for compute-communication overlap scenarios is 12.97%. This error range is sufficient to support screening for optimal deployment configurations. In comparative tests, traversing 2 fusion settings, 7 batch sizes, and 32 input lengths for the Llama3-70B prefill phase required 12 hours of running on an 8-GPU server plus extensive engineering work for traditional profiling, while EnergyLens only takes 15 minutes to generate results and visualizations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3's distributed energy modeling stack design, including MoE load imbalance modeling and compute-communication overlap aggregation logic; the appendix's error source analysis helps understand the model's applicable boundaries. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

paper.title: Ada-MK: Adaptive MegaKernel Optimization via Automated DAG-based Search for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: When large language models (LLMs) serve real-time inference in commercial online advertising systems, end-to-end latency must be strictly bounded to the millisecond range. Yet every token generated during the decode phase triggers thousands of kernel launches, and kernel launch overhead alone can account for 14.6% of end-to-end inference time. MegaKernel eliminates launch overhead and inter-operator HBM round-trips by fusing multiple operators into a single persistent kernel. However, existing M

summary.core_problem: 在毫秒级强时延约束的线上场景（广告系统）里，LLM decode 阶段存在大量 kernel launch 与算子间 HBM 往返，导致端到端时延被 launch overhead 和内存流量主导；MegaKernel 虽能通过算子融合与 persistent kernel 缓解，但在 NVIDIA Ada（L20）这类共享内存更小、缺少原生 TMA 的 GPU 上，很难同时做到“足够快、可移植、且无运行时动态调度抖动”。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统/编译优化论文，不是预训练方法论文；对基座预训练的直接贡献有限。但它把一个常被忽略的约束讲得很具体：在真实线上 1–5ms SLA 下，任何运行时分支、动态调度、以及过度依赖新架构特性的优化都会变成不稳定因素。对做 pretrain 的启发主要在工程闭环：模型结构选择（如 attention/MLP 形态、KV cache 访问模式）会反过来决定能否做深度融合与稳定低延迟服务，从而影响“可训练—可部署”的整体最优。
summary.technical_approach:
Ada-MK 的核心是把 MegaKernel 在 Ada 上落地，并把“动态决策”尽量前移到离线：
1) 自适应共享内存管理：把 shared memory 需求建模为硬件规格×模型结构×动态 workload 的函数，通过 K 维度细粒度切分（K-dimension splitting）降低峰值 shared memory（文中声称可降 50%），并做跨算子 page 复用，以在 128KB/SM 的约束下重建可用的 producer-consumer pipeline。
2) DAG 级自动搜索：用 MLIR lowering 构建到 PTX 级的依赖 DAG，在离线 profiling 中固化“最优执行 trace”，运行时直接按序执行，避免 Mirage MPK 那类 managed pointer/页状态 if-else 带来的指令发射效率下降与尾延迟抖动。这里的关键取舍是：牺牲部分在线自适应，换取确定性与更低的控制开销。
3) 异构混合推理引擎：作为 TensorRT-LLM plugin 集成，Prefill 继续用 TensorRT-LLM 原生算子（更通用、对长序列/大 batch 友好），Decode 切到 MegaKernel（更低 launch 与更少 HBM round-trip）。这相当于承认“prefill/decode 最优实现不同”，用系统层切换来拿到两边的收益。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的关键量化点包括：在 Qwen2.5-1.5B + TensorRT-LLM 的 profile 中，kernel launch overhead 约占端到端 14.6%（约 1,655,550 次 launch，累计约 3.3s 的 launch 时间，具体测量口径来自 Nsight Systems）。在多种 Qwen 系列模型上，相比 vLLM / SGLang / vanilla TensorRT-LLM，端到端时延降低 10%–50%，并已在百度商业广告系统上线。全文片段未包含更细的表格数字（如具体 batch/seq、prefill vs decode 拆分、p50/p99、吞吐-时延曲线、以及与 Hopper 上 MegaKernel 的对照），这些需要在实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 的约束设定与 profile 数字，确认它解决的是“确定性低时延”而非纯吞吐。
- 重点看系统结构图（Figure 1）理解离线合成 vs 在线执行的边界，以及为何要做 Prefill/Decode 异构切换。
- 精看三处机制：K 维切分如何降低 shared memory 峰值、跨算子 page 复用的生命周期管理、以及 DAG trace 固化如何消除运行时分支。
- 实验部分建议优先找：p99 时延、不同序列长度/并发下的稳定性、以及与 Mirage MPK/手写 kernel 的对比，判断“离线固化”是否牺牲了泛化到更多形状的能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Under strict 1–5ms SLA in production (online ads), LLM decoding suffers from massive kernel-launch overhead and inter-op HBM round-trips. MegaKernel-style fusion can remove much of this overhead, but deploying it on NVIDIA Ada (e.g., L20)—with smaller shared memory and no native TMA—faces a portability–efficiency–determinism trade-off: hand-tuned kernels are brittle, while auto-compiled approaches often introduce runtime branching/scheduling that hurts ultra-low-latency stability.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference/compilation systems paper rather than a pretraining-method paper, so its direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited. The useful takeaway for pretraining researchers is the “train–serve closure”: architectural choices (operator shapes, KV-cache access patterns, attention/MLP layouts) constrain how far operator fusion and persistent-kernel execution can go, and in real SLA-bound deployments, runtime dynamism (branches, adaptive scheduling) can be worse than a slightly suboptimal but deterministic plan.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Ada-MK adapts MegaKernel to Ada GPUs by pushing decisions offline and minimizing runtime control overhead:
1) Adaptive shared-memory management: model shared-memory usage as a function of hardware, model architecture, and workload; reduce peak shared-memory demand (claimed ~50%) via fine-grained splitting along the K dimension, and enable cross-operator page reuse to fit viable pipelines within Ada’s 128KB/SM constraint.
2) Fine-grained DAG-based auto-search: build PTX-level dependency DAGs via MLIR lowering, then profile offline to select and serialize an optimal execution trace. At runtime, execute the fixed trace to avoid the if-else branching and dynamic scheduling overhead seen in approaches like managed-pointer mechanisms.
3) Heterogeneous hybrid engine: integrate as a TensorRT-LLM plugin—use TensorRT-LLM native operators for Prefill (better generality for long sequences/large batches) and switch to MegaKernel for Decode (to cut launches and HBM traffic). The key design choice is explicitly separating prefill vs decode implementations instead of forcing one kernel strategy to cover both.
summary_en.experiments: Reported highlights include: profiling Qwen2.5-1.5B under TensorRT-LLM shows kernel-launch overhead is ~14.6% of end-to-end time (~1,655,550 launches, ~3.3s cumulative launch time). Across Qwen model variants, Ada-MK reduces end-to-end latency by 10%–50% versus vLLM, SGLang, and vanilla TensorRT-LLM, and is deployed in Baidu’s production ads system. The provided excerpt does not include the detailed tables (e.g., p50/p99, shape coverage, prefill vs decode breakdown), which should be verified in the full evaluation section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Start with the profiling evidence and SLA constraints in the Introduction to understand the objective (deterministic low latency, not just throughput).
- Read the architecture overview (Figure 1) to internalize the offline synthesis vs online execution boundary and the prefill/decode split.
- Focus on three mechanisms: K-dimension splitting for shared-memory peak reduction, cross-op page reuse, and how DAG-trace serialization removes runtime branching.
- In evaluation, prioritize tail latency (p99), stability across sequence lengths/concurrency, and comparisons against Mirage MPK and hand-tuned kernels to judge the determinism–generality trade-off.

paper.title: Mitigating Context-Memory Conflicts in LLMs through Dynamic Cognitive Reconciliation Decoding
paper.abstract: Large language models accumulate extensive parametric knowledge through pre-training. However, knowledge conflicts occur when outdated or incorrect parametric knowledge conflicts with external knowledge in the context. Existing methods address knowledge conflicts through contrastive decoding, but in conflict-free scenarios, static approaches disrupt output distribution. Other dynamic decoding methods attempt to measure the degree of conflict but still struggle with complex real-world situations.

paper.title: Requests of a Feather Must Flock Together: Batch Size vs. Prefix Homogeneity in LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Auto-regressive token generation in large language models is memory-bound because it requires "attending to" key and value tensors (KV cache) of all previous tokens. Prior work aims to improve the efficiency of this decode process by batching multiple requests together, and maximizing batch size subject to GPU memory constraints. The key observation of our work is that with prefix-sharing workloads, smaller, prefix-homogeneous batches -- where all requests share a common prefix -- can achieve hi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 LLM 推理服务里的一个具体但很常见的误区：decode 阶段调度是否只要尽量把 batch 做大就好。作者指出，在存在大量 prefix sharing 的真实工作负载里，batch size 不是唯一主导因素，prefix homogeneity——同一 batch 内请求共享公共前缀的程度——往往更重要。原因是 decode 是典型 memory-bound 过程，性能瓶颈在 KV cache 的 DRAM 访问；如果一个 batch 内请求共享长前缀，就能在 KV 读取上获得更好的时空局部性，减少 DRAM 流量并提高带宽利用。因此，较小但前缀更一致的 batch，可能比更大的异构 batch 吞吐更高。现有 prefix-aware scheduler 主要把前缀共享当成“节省 KV 内存”的手段，没有把它当成 decode 吞吐优化目标，也没有处理 prefix-aware 调度本身的 CPU 开销问题。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，应归到 efficient / serving。对基座研究的间接价值在于，它把一个常被忽略的 serving 事实讲得很清楚：在长上下文和高共享前缀场景下，系统瓶颈不是抽象的 FLOPs，而是 KV 访问模式。这个结论会反过来影响预训练和产品侧的一些设计选择，比如 system prompt、few-shot 模板、RAG 拼接方式、prefix cache 组织、甚至模型是否值得为 shared-prefix attention kernel 做专门适配。贡献量级在系统论文里不小，因为它不是单纯换一个调度启发式，而是提出了“batch size 与 prefix homogeneity 之间存在最优平衡”的性能模型直觉，并给出低开销实现。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Feather 调度器，目标是在 decode 阶段显式平衡 batch size 和 prefix homogeneity，而不是一味追求最大 batch。论文先通过受控实验说明：当一组请求共享长公共前缀时，把它们放进同一个较小 batch，可以让 attention 对共享 KV block 的访问更集中，带来更高的 spatial locality 和 temporal locality；但 batch 也不能过小，否则算力利用率下降。所以最优点取决于共享前缀长度、batch 大小和硬件特性。

为此，Feather 设计了两个关键组件。第一是 Chunked Hash Tree, CHT。它不用 token-level radix tree 去维护前缀关系，而是把每个请求表示成 cumulative prefix hashes 的向量，按 chunk 维护共享前缀信息。这样可以快速判断两个请求共享到哪个 chunk，避免频繁树遍历。第二是一个基于 min-heap 的选择机制，用来在当前 active batch 上近似找到“加入后能最大化公共前缀长度、同时不过度牺牲 batch size”的请求。heap 采用 lazy update，减少每次调度时的 CPU 维护成本。作者强调，这和 SGLang / vLLM 里为了减少 KV eviction 而做的 prefix-aware 排序不同；Feather 的目标函数直接面向 decode throughput，而不是单纯内存复用。

从系统角度看，论文还把 prefix homogeneity 的收益和 prefix-aware attention kernel 联系起来：如果 kernel 本身能对共享前缀做联合 attention 计算，那么调度器把相似请求凑到一起，收益会进一步放大。也就是说，Feather 不是孤立优化，而是调度层与 kernel 层协同。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的发现有三个。第一，在 prefix-sharing workload 上，prefix homogeneity 对吞吐的影响可以超过 batch size。文中给出的代表性例子是：800 个请求被分成 8 组，每组 100 个请求共享 10K token 的长前缀。把它们按 8 个 prefix-homogeneous batch 处理，decode throughput 接近比更大的 heterogeneous batch 高 2 倍；但如果继续切得太碎，比如 32 个 batch、每批 25 个请求，又会因为计算利用率不足而变差。这直接支持“存在中间最优点”的主张。

第二，现有 prefix-aware scheduler 的 CPU 开销很高。作者报告 radix-tree 维护和遍历在某些设置下可占总延迟的 50%–90%，这意味着即便 GPU 侧有收益，调度器本身也可能把收益吃掉。Feather 通过 CHT 和 lazy heap 显著降低了这部分开销。

第三，Feather 在真实或半真实 prefix-shared 负载上，相比 FCFS 和现有 prefix-aware 基线都能提升整体吞吐，并且在共享前缀更长、请求更成簇时收益更明显。你给出的全文片段没有完整结果表和所有硬件配置，我不编造具体平均提升数字；但文中已经明确给出一个近 2× 的受控案例，以及 CPU overhead 50%–90% 这一很关键的诊断结果。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合系统向泛读。先看 Introduction 前半，确认 decode 为什么是 memory-bound，以及 prefix sharing 为什么会改变 KV 访问模式。然后重点看 3.1 和 3.2：这里是整篇最有信息量的部分，作者用实验把“batch 越大越好”的直觉拆掉，并说明为什么现有调度器没有抓住真正的性能目标。3.3 也值得看，因为很多系统论文只谈 GPU kernel，不谈 CPU 调度成本，这篇把调度元开销量化得比较直接。方法部分重点看 CHT 数据结构和 heap 选择策略，不必陷入实现细枝末节，只要抓住它为什么比 radix tree 更轻。实验部分优先看 controlled study、end-to-end throughput、CPU overhead breakdown。如果只想抓核心结论，30 分钟左右够；如果你做 serving 系统，建议连附录里关于名称、实现和复杂度的部分一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper challenges a common serving assumption: during LLM decode, is maximizing batch size always the right objective? The authors argue no. For workloads with substantial prefix sharing, prefix homogeneity within a batch can matter more than raw batch size. Decode is memory-bound because each generated token must sweep the KV cache. If all requests in a batch share a long prefix, KV accesses exhibit much better spatial and temporal locality, reducing DRAM traffic and improving effective bandwidth utilization. As a result, a smaller but prefix-homogeneous batch can outperform a larger heterogeneous one. Existing prefix-aware schedulers mostly exploit shared prefixes to save KV memory, not to optimize decode throughput, and they often incur large CPU overheads while maintaining prefix data structures.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency/serving paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its indirect value to foundation-model work is that it sharpens the systems picture around long-context inference: the bottleneck is often not abstract FLOPs but the access pattern over KV cache. That matters for product-side prompt design, system prompts, few-shot templates, RAG layouts, prefix-cache organization, and whether it is worth co-designing kernels for shared-prefix attention. The contribution is meaningful at the systems level because it does more than propose another heuristic scheduler. It identifies a real tradeoff between batch size and prefix homogeneity, demonstrates that the optimum can sit away from maximum batch size, and provides a low-overhead implementation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core system is Feather, a decode scheduler that explicitly balances batch size against prefix homogeneity instead of always pushing for the largest feasible batch. The paper first uses controlled experiments to show why this tradeoff exists. When requests in a batch share a long common prefix, attention over shared KV blocks becomes much more locality-friendly. That improves both temporal reuse and spatial coalescing of memory accesses. But making batches too small hurts compute utilization. So the best operating point depends on shared-prefix length, batch size, and hardware behavior.

Feather has two main components. The first is the Chunked Hash Tree (CHT). Rather than maintaining token-level radix-tree traversals, CHT represents each request as a vector of cumulative prefix hashes over chunks. This allows fast estimation of how much prefix two requests share, while avoiding heavy tree maintenance. The second is a min-heap-based selection mechanism that approximately chooses the next request to maximize common-prefix length within the active batch without sacrificing too much batch size. The heap is updated lazily to reduce CPU scheduling overhead. This differs from prior prefix-aware schedulers in systems like SGLang or vLLM, which mainly exploit prefix structure to reduce KV evictions or memory footprint. Feather’s objective is decode throughput itself.

An important systems point is that Feather composes naturally with prefix-aware attention kernels. If the kernel can jointly process queries that share prefixes, then a scheduler that forms more homogeneous batches amplifies those kernel-level gains. So the paper is really about scheduler–kernel co-design, not just queue ordering.
summary_en.experiments:
Three empirical findings matter most. First, on prefix-sharing workloads, prefix homogeneity can dominate batch size. The headline controlled example in the paper uses 800 requests partitioned into 8 groups of 100, where each group shares a 10K-token prefix. Processing them as 8 prefix-homogeneous batches yields nearly 2x higher throughput than using larger heterogeneous batches. But if the batches are made too small, such as 32 batches of 25, throughput drops again because compute utilization becomes poor. This directly supports the claim that there is an interior optimum rather than a monotonic preference for larger batches.

Second, the CPU cost of existing prefix-aware schedulers is surprisingly high. The paper reports that radix-tree maintenance and traversal can account for 50% to 90% of total latency in some settings. That is a critical diagnosis: even if GPU-side prefix reuse helps, the scheduler itself can erase the gain. Feather reduces this overhead through CHT and lazy heap updates.

Third, on realistic or semi-realistic prefix-shared workloads, Feather improves end-to-end throughput over FCFS and prior prefix-aware baselines, with larger gains when requests cluster around longer shared prefixes. The excerpt provided here does not include the full result tables or all hardware details, so I will not fabricate exact average improvements. The paper does clearly establish the near-2x controlled case and the 50–90% scheduler-overhead finding.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a good skim for anyone working on inference systems. Start with the introduction to refresh why decode is memory-bound and why shared prefixes change the KV access pattern. Then go straight to Sections 3.1 and 3.2. Those sections contain the main insight: larger batches are not always better, and current schedulers optimize the wrong thing for prefix-shared decode. Section 3.3 is also worth reading because it quantifies CPU scheduling overhead, which many serving papers underplay. In the method section, focus on the intuition behind CHT and the heap-based request selection; you do not need every implementation detail to understand why it is lighter than radix trees. In the experiments, prioritize the controlled studies, end-to-end throughput results, and the CPU overhead breakdown. Around 30 minutes is enough for the main idea; if you build serving systems, the appendix on implementation details is worth the extra time.

recommendation.zh: 挑战了推理引擎中“Batch Size 越大越好”的 prior，指出在共享前缀场景下，同质小 Batch 因为 KV Cache 局部性更好反而吞吐更高，做 Serving 和 vLLM 优化的同学必看。
recommendation.en: Challenges the 'larger batch size is better' prior in inference engines, pointing out that in prefix-sharing scenarios, homogeneous small batches achieve higher throughput due to better KV Cache locality; a must-read for those working on Serving and vLLM optimization.

paper.title: Towards Generation-Efficient Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Uncertainty estimation is important for deploying LLMs in high-stakes applications such as healthcare and finance, where hallucinations can appear fluent and plausible while being factually incorrect, making it difficult for users to judge whether an output should be trusted. Existing methods require one or more full autoregressive generations to estimate uncertainty, which introduces substantial inference cost and often delays uncertainty assessment. In this paper, we investigate whether effect

summary.core_problem: 在不做（或少做）自回归生成的前提下，能否对 LLM 最终输出的可靠性/不确定性做出有效估计，从而把“不确定”尽量提前暴露出来，降低多次采样或完整生成带来的延迟与算力成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接改动不多，但对“生成式模型的置信度信号来自哪里”给了一个可操作的分解：把不确定性估计视为沿解码过程的 early estimation，并展示了仅看部分 token 甚至只看输入也能接近单次完整生成的不确定性质量。对训练侧的启发在于：logit 尺度（softmax 之前的证据强度）可能是比概率熵更稳定的可迁移信号；同时用“生成得到的内部信号”给一个轻量模型做伪标注，提供了一条把推理时信号蒸馏回前置模块的路径。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先给不确定性估计方法按“观察到多少生成信息”做了谱系：多次生成（disagreement）、单次完整序列（序列熵/证据分数/隐状态特征）、部分生成、仅输入。
核心方法有两个：
1) Logit Magnitude（部分生成）：在每个解码步 t 取 logits 向量的 L2 范数作为 token 级不确定性/证据强度指标（直觉是 softmax 会抹平绝对尺度，而 logits 的幅值保留了模型‘证据强弱’信息）。然后对已生成前缀做聚合：不是简单平均，而是取 top-M 个“最有信息量”的 token 分数做聚合，避免长文本里大量平庸 token 稀释信号。并配合自适应 early-stop：当估计已足够稳定/达到阈值时提前停止继续生成，用更少 token 得到序列级不确定性。
2) MetaUE（输入-only）：用冻结的预训练 encoder + 小 MLP，从 prompt 直接预测 Logit Magnitude 的序列级分数。训练时不需要人工不确定性标签，而是用 Logit Magnitude（来自部分/完整生成）作为伪标签，把“生成阶段才能看到的信号”蒸馏成“生成前就能预测”的模块。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖通用与医疗域数据集、不同 LLM 家族与规模，并包含 MoE 架构的验证。主要结论是：
- 部分生成的 Logit Magnitude 在显著减少生成 token 的情况下，能给出与单次完整生成方法相近的排序/区分能力（论文主张其在低生成成本下仍具竞争力）。
- 输入-only 的 MetaUE 在零生成成本下仍能提供可用的不确定性估计，作为部署时的前置风险提示。
给出的摘要片段未包含具体指标口径（如 AUROC/PR-AUC、与 baselines 的差值、平均节省 token 比例等）与详细数字；精读时需要从实验章节核对：不同任务上“节省多少生成长度”对应“性能掉多少”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按三个点读：
1) 方法动机与定义：看他们为何选 logits 的幅值而不是熵/最大概率，token 级到序列级的聚合为何用 top-M（对应哪些失败模式）。
2) early-stop 机制：阈值/稳定性判据如何设定，是否对不同模型/温度/采样策略敏感。
3) MetaUE 训练细节：伪标签来自“部分生成还是完整生成”、prompt encoder 选型、训练数据分布与跨域泛化。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现或迁移到自家模型，需要额外精读实验设置与超参。

summary_en.core_problem: How to estimate an LLM’s output uncertainty without paying the full cost of autoregressive decoding—ideally from a short prefix, or even from the prompt alone—so uncertainty can be surfaced early and cheaply.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it sharpens a practical question that feeds back into modeling: where do reliable confidence signals live during decoding? The paper argues that much of the useful signal is concentrated early and that the absolute scale of logits (pre-softmax) can act as a robust “evidence strength” feature. The prompt-only distillation (using generation-derived pseudo-labels) is also a reusable pattern: convert expensive, generation-time internal signals into a cheap pre-generation predictor.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper frames uncertainty estimation as an early-estimation problem along the AR trajectory and organizes methods by how much generation they observe (multi-sample, single full sequence, partial generation, input-only).
Two main components:
1) Logit Magnitude (partial generation): at each step, compute the L2 norm of the logits vector as a token-level score. Aggregate to a sequence-level uncertainty using a top-M pooling over the prefix (to focus on the most informative steps rather than averaging everything). Add an adaptive early-stop rule so the estimator can stop decoding once the uncertainty estimate is deemed sufficient.
2) MetaUE (input-only): a lightweight meta-model (frozen pretrained encoder + small MLP head) predicts the Logit Magnitude score directly from the prompt. Training uses Logit Magnitude as pseudo-labels, distilling a decoding-time estimator into a zero-generation predictor.
summary_en.experiments: They report experiments across general and medical datasets, multiple model families/sizes, and include MoE models. The headline claim is that partial-generation Logit Magnitude remains competitive with full-generation single-pass baselines while using fewer generated tokens, and that MetaUE provides usable uncertainty at zero decoding cost. The provided excerpt does not include the exact metrics (e.g., AUROC/PR-AUC), token savings, or per-dataset numbers; those need to be pulled from the main experiment tables/figures in the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on: (1) the justification for logit-scale features vs entropy/probability-based scores; (2) the top-M aggregation choice and what failure modes it addresses; (3) the early-stop criterion and its sensitivity to sampling settings; (4) MetaUE training details—pseudo-label source, encoder choice, and cross-domain generalization. ~30–45 minutes to get the core idea; longer if you want to port it to a different decoding stack.

recommendation.zh: 将不确定性估计转化为早期估计问题，探索了仅用 partial generation 甚至 input-only 预测不确定性的方法，对降低可信 LLM 部署成本有启发，关注 Serving 效率的同学可看。
recommendation.en: Formulates uncertainty estimation as an early estimation problem, exploring methods to predict uncertainty using only partial generation or input-only information; inspiring for reducing the deployment cost of trustworthy LLMs, worth reading for those focused on Serving efficiency.

paper.title: CoQuant: Joint Weight-Activation Subspace Projection for Mixed-Precision LLMs
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become an important technique for reducing the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs). While recent mixed-precision methods improve ultra-low bit quantization by preserving critical subspaces in high precision, they typically construct these subspaces relying solely on activation statistics. summary.core_problem: 现有混合精度训练后量化方法仅基于激活统计选择高精度保留子空间，忽略线性层输出扰动由权重与激活量化噪声共同驱动的本质，导致超低位量化精度损失过高
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出联合权重-激活的子空间投影PTQ方法，显著提升超低位量化的模型效果
summary.technical_approach: 提出CoQuant，通过理论建模线性层输出期望误差，推导闭式加权PCA解，同时平衡激活与权重协方差选择最优高精度保留子空间
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3.2、Qwen2.5系列模型上验证，WikiText困惑度与零样本常识推理精度均优于现有主流PTQ基线
summary.authors_note: 南京邮电大学物联网学院团队，无公开知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mixed-precision post-training quantization methods select high-precision preserved subspaces only based on activation statistics, ignoring the nature that linear layer output perturbation is jointly driven by weight and activation quantization noise, leading to high accuracy loss in ultra-low bit quantization
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a joint weight-activation subspace projection PTQ method that significantly improves model performance under ultra-low bit quantization
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CoQuant, models the expected output error of linear layers theoretically, derives a closed-form weighted PCA solution that balances activation and weight covariance to select the optimal high-precision preserved subspace
summary_en.experiments: Verified on Llama-3.2 and Qwen2.5 models, outperforms existing mainstream PTQ baselines on both WikiText perplexity and zero-shot common sense reasoning accuracy
summary_en.authors_note: Team from School of Internet of Things, Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications, no publicly well-known authors

recommendation.zh: 加权PCA选择高精度子空间的思路可用于预训练量化感知训练的子空间保留设计，仅看公式推导部分即可
recommendation.en: The weighted PCA based high-precision subspace selection logic can be referenced for quantization-aware pre-training design, only read the formula derivation section.

paper.title: Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs
paper.abstract: NVIDIA's CUDA Tile (CuTile) introduces a Python-based, tile-centric abstraction for GPU kernel development that aims to simplify programming while retaining Tensor Core and Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) efficiency on modern GPUs. We present the first independent, cross-architecture evaluation of CuTile against established approaches such as cuBLAS, Triton, WMMA, and raw SIMT on three NVIDIA GPUs spanning Hopper and Blackwell: H100 NVL, B200, and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition. We benchm

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评估 NVIDIA CUDA Tile 在 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 上是否适合 AI 工作负载，尤其是 GEMM、融合多头注意力和端到端 LLM 推理。核心问题很工程化：CuTile 能否在减少 kernel 开发成本的同时，接近或超过 cuBLAS、Triton、WMMA、FlashAttention-2 等成熟实现的性能。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的价值在训练与推理基础设施判断。CuTile 不是新的建模方法，但它影响 Blackwell 时代 kernel 开发的取舍。论文给出的结论比较明确：CuTile 在 B200 上的融合注意力表现突出，但不适合直接替代标准 GEMM 的 cuBLAS；如果集群同时包含 Hopper 和 Blackwell，Triton 的可移植性仍然更稳。对预训练团队来说，这类结果可以帮助判断哪些算子值得投入新 DSL 迁移，哪些继续依赖 vendor library 或 Triton。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 CuTile 放在性能和开发效率两个维度上评估。对比对象包括 cuBLAS、Triton、CuTile、WMMA 和 raw SIMT。CuTile 使用 Python 中的 tile-centric 抽象，通过 ct.load、ct.mma、ct.store 表达 TMA 加载、Tensor Core 计算和写回，并通过 ByTarget 做架构相关调参。它的主要限制是只支持 Blackwell，依赖 CUDA Toolkit 13.1 中的 tileiras 编译器，不能覆盖 Hopper。实验平台包括 H100 NVL、B200 和 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition。工作负载包括 BF16/FP16 GEMM、基于 online softmax 的融合多头注意力，以及端到端 LLM 推理。GEMM 形状覆盖 4096 到 16384 的方阵，以及 transformer FFN 中常见的 4096/11008 维度组合。
summary.experiments: 关键数字集中在三个结论。第一，在 B200 上，CuTile 的融合注意力达到最高 1007 TFLOP/s，比 FlashAttention-2 高 2.5 倍，并且 kernel 代码约 60 行。第二，在标准 GEMM 上，CuTile 只有 cuBLAS 吞吐的 52% 到 79%，因此对 torch.matmul 或 cuBLAS 已经覆盖的矩阵乘没有明显替代动机；但它比 WMMA 快 1.5 到 5.0 倍，且代码量约 22 行，相比 WMMA 的 123 行更省工程成本。第三，Triton 在三类 GPU 上保持 cuBLAS 约 62% 到 101% 的性能，跨架构可移植性更好。论文还指出 workstation-class Blackwell 的表现不稳定：在 RTX PRO 6000 上，CuTile 融合注意力只有 FlashAttention-2 的 53%，说明编译器和架构适配仍有明显差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 15 到 20 分钟即可。先看引言末尾的五条结论，它们基本覆盖工程决策。然后看硬件平台表，确认 B200、RTX PRO 6000 和 H100 的差异，因为 CuTile 结果高度依赖架构。方法部分建议重点看 GEMM shape、FMHA 实现和精度设置，避免把单个 kernel 结果泛化到所有训练场景。若正在做 Blackwell kernel 迁移，优先看融合注意力结果和 CuTile 对 TMA、Tensor Core 的抽象方式；若目标是混合集群训练，Triton 与 CuTile 的可移植性对比更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether NVIDIA CUDA Tile is a practical programming model for AI kernels on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs. The central question is operational: can CuTile reduce kernel-development effort while matching or improving the performance of established implementations such as cuBLAS, Triton, WMMA, and FlashAttention-2 for GEMM, fused attention, and LLM inference workloads.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model work is infrastructure-level. CuTile is not a modeling contribution, but it affects how teams may write and maintain kernels on Blackwell systems. The paper gives useful adoption boundaries. CuTile looks attractive for fused attention on datacenter Blackwell, but it should not replace cuBLAS for standard GEMM. For heterogeneous fleets that include Hopper and Blackwell, Triton remains the safer portability choice. These conclusions matter for pretraining teams deciding where new kernel DSL migration is worth the engineering cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares five implementation styles: cuBLAS through torch.matmul, Triton with autotuning, CuTile, hand-written CUDA WMMA, and raw SIMT. CuTile exposes a Python tile-centric abstraction with ct.load, ct.mma, and ct.store for TMA-backed memory movement, Tensor Core matrix multiply-accumulate, and stores. ByTarget is used for architecture-specific tuning such as CTA clustering. A key constraint is that CuTile currently targets Blackwell GPUs and depends on the tileiras compiler in CUDA Toolkit 13.1; it does not support Hopper. The evaluation covers H100 NVL, B200, and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition. Workloads include BF16/FP16 GEMM, fused multi-head attention using an online softmax algorithm, and end-to-end LLM inference. GEMM shapes include square matrices from 4096 to 16384 and transformer FFN-like dimensions involving 4096 and 11008.
summary_en.experiments: The main results are clear. On B200, CuTile fused attention reaches up to 1007 TFLOP/s, about 2.5 times FlashAttention-2 in the reported setup, with roughly 60 lines of Python kernel code. For standard GEMM, CuTile reaches only 52% to 79% of cuBLAS throughput, so it is not a replacement for well-covered torch.matmul or cuBLAS paths. It is, however, much better than WMMA on Blackwell, delivering 1.5 to 5.0 times higher throughput with about 22 lines of code versus 123 lines for the WMMA implementation. Triton maintains roughly 62% to 101% of cuBLAS performance across the tested GPUs, including Hopper, making it stronger for portability. The workstation Blackwell result is a cautionary point: on RTX PRO 6000, CuTile fused attention reaches only 53% of FlashAttention-2 throughput, suggesting that compiler maturity and Blackwell variants matter.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15 to 20 minutes. Start with the conclusion bullets in the introduction; they are the most actionable part. Then check the hardware table, because CuTile behavior depends heavily on whether the target is B200 or a workstation-class Blackwell GPU. In the methodology, focus on GEMM shapes, fused-attention setup, precision, and autotuning details. For Blackwell kernel migration, the fused-attention section and the CuTile abstraction over TMA and Tensor Cores are the most useful. For mixed Hopper/Blackwell training clusters, the Triton-versus-CuTile portability comparison is more important than the peak B200 number.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention 与 GEMM 两组表即可；CuTile 不是预训练方法，但 Blackwell kernel prior 需要更新。
recommendation.en: Read the attention and GEMM tables only; CuTile is not a pretraining idea, but it updates practical Blackwell kernel priors.

paper.title: CSAttention: Centroid-Scoring Attention for Accelerating LLM Inference

summary.core_problem: 论文关注长上下文 LLM 在线解码阶段的核心瓶颈：注意力计算与 KV-cache 访问/搬运成本（尤其在离线 prefill、在线 decode 的“Write-Once, Read-Many”复用场景）。问题是：在极高稀疏率下，如何在不训练/不改模型的前提下做稀疏注意力，同时避免 Query-Key 分布漂移导致的召回下降与质量劣化，并保持 GPU 友好的高吞吐实现？
summary.importance: 长上下文服务中，KV cache 的线性增长会迅速耗尽 HBM 并触发 CPU↔GPU 分页，导致带宽/延迟成为主导成本；即使有 GQA/MQA 也难以根治。稀疏注意力能同时减少 FLOPs 与“触达的 KV 数量”，但高稀疏下常因索引结构与在线 Query 分布不匹配而掉点。若能在复用 prefill 的设定下把复杂计算前置到离线阶段，并在在线阶段实现稳定高召回的稀疏检索，将直接提升长上下文推理吞吐与成本效率。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 CSAttention（Centroid-Scoring Attention），一种 training-free 的稀疏注意力，核心是“以存储换计算”的离线构建 + 在线常数开销检索。
- 离线 prefill（一次性，可跨多请求摊销）：将特征空间划分为 m 个子空间；对 prefill 阶段的 Queries 在每个子空间做聚类得到 C 个质心。对每个质心，预计算其与该子空间所有 Keys 的部分点积（centroid-scores），并为每个质心维护压缩的 Top-L 列表（key 索引 + 分数）。
- 在线 decode（每步）：对新 Query，在每个子空间选择最近的 1 个质心（1-of-C），取回 m 个短列表；在 GPU 上按 key index 做分数累加（跨子空间的部分分数求和），再选出 Top-k key 做稀疏注意力。直觉是：真正相关的 key 会在多个子空间上同时获得较高 centroid-score，通过“子空间累加”在高稀疏下仍能浮现。
- 增量维护：解码过程中新增 keys 到来时，仅尝试插入对应质心的 Top-L（若部分分数超过当前最小值），从而保持表容量有界、更新开销很小。
关键设计动机：传统 key-centric 聚类/索引在高稀疏下容易被 Q/K 分布漂移击穿；CSAttention 用 query-centric 的离线表去贴合 Query 几何，并用规则化的数据结构与少量 kernel 避免在线不规则访存与控制流，从而兼顾召回与吞吐。
summary.experiments: 从引言可知论文主要面向长上下文 serving，并强调在 95% 稀疏等极端设置下仍能保持较高召回/性能，同时显著减少在线解码的计算与 KV 传输；并且适配“离线 prefill 构建、在线 decode 复用”的系统形态（KV/索引可放在 CPU DRAM/SSD，按需加载）。具体实验指标通常会包括：困惑度/下游准确率保持、不同稀疏率下质量-速度曲线、prefill 构建开销与摊销分析、GPU kernel 利用率/吞吐、以及与 token eviction、SparQ、PQ/ANN、LSH 等方法对比（需在正文实验章节核对）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + 重点章节/图表/创新点）
1) Introduction：明确系统设定（offline prefill / online decode、可复用长提示），以及作者对“瓶颈在 KV cache 与带宽而非纯 FLOPs”的论证；抓住 Q/K distribution shift 是高稀疏失败的根因。
2) 方法章节：精读三块——(i) 子空间划分（m）与聚类（C）的定义；(ii) centroid-score 的预计算与 Top-L 压缩表的数据布局；(iii) 在线累加与 Top-k 选择的 GPU 实现路径（哪些操作是规则化、可并行的）。
3) 增量更新策略：关注新增 key 如何更新多个质心表、复杂度是否与 C 或 m 相关、以及为何能“可忽略”。
4) 关键图表：优先看“质量-稀疏率-吞吐”三者关系的主图（通常是不同 sparsity 下的 ppl/acc 与 tokens/s），以及 offline build 成本与摊销点（多少次复用后回本）。
5) 消融：重点核对 query-centric vs key-centric、是否需要子空间累加、Top-L 容量对召回的影响、以及在长生成（query drift）下的鲁棒性曲线。
创新点清单：A) 面向复用 prefill 的 query-centric 离线索引；B) centroid-score + 子空间累加的高稀疏检索机制；C) 有界容量 Top-L 表 + 轻量增量维护；D) 以规则 GPU kernel 为中心的在线执行路径，避免全上下文扫描。

skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + 推荐看哪些部分）
- 读 Introduction：理解应用场景与为何现有稀疏/索引在高稀疏下不稳。
- 直接看方法总览图/伪代码（prefill 构建 vs decode 检索两阶段）。
- 快速扫主结果：在 90–95% 稀疏下的质量保持与吞吐提升，以及与基线对比。
- 最后扫参数 m/C/L 的经验设置与敏感性结论，便于落地复现。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：在可复用长上下文服务中，应把“昂贵但可摊销”的工作尽量前置到离线 prefill；而要在极高稀疏下保持质量，索引结构必须贴合 Query 的几何而非仅围绕 Keys 构建。CSAttention 用 query-centric 质心表与子空间累加，在不训练模型的前提下追求高召回与高吞吐的统一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the dominant bottleneck in long-context LLM serving during online decoding: attention and, more critically, KV-cache access/transfer under an offline-prefill / online-decode “write-once, read-many” reuse pattern. The challenge is to achieve very high sparsity without training or modifying the model, while avoiding quality loss caused by Query–Key distribution shift and maintaining GPU-friendly high-throughput execution.
summary_en.importance: In long-context inference, KV cache grows linearly with context length and quickly exceeds GPU HBM, triggering CPU↔GPU paging and making bandwidth/latency the limiting factor. Sparse attention can reduce both FLOPs and the amount of KV touched per step, but at high sparsity many indexing schemes break due to Q/K distribution shift and compounding errors over long generations. A method that front-loads work into amortizable offline prefill and keeps online decoding bounded and robust directly improves throughput and cost for long-context deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose CSAttention (Centroid-Scoring Attention), a training-free sparse attention method built around a storage-for-computation tradeoff.
- Offline prefill (one-time, amortized): split the feature space into m subspaces; cluster prefill queries in each subspace into C centroids. For each centroid, precompute partial dot-products with all keys in that subspace (centroid-scores) and store a compressed, bounded Top-L list (key indices + scores).
- Online decode (per step): for a new query, pick the nearest centroid in each subspace (1-of-C), fetch the m short lists, and accumulate partial scores by key index on GPU. Keys that align with the query tend to score well across multiple subspaces and rise to the top after accumulation; then select Top-k keys for sparse attention.
- Incremental maintenance: as new keys arrive during decoding, attempt to insert them into the relevant centroids’ Top-L lists only if their partial score exceeds the current minimum, keeping capacity bounded and update overhead small.
The key idea is query-centric indexing to mitigate Q/K distribution shift, plus regular, GPU-friendly data structures/kernels to avoid full-context scans and irregular control flow.
summary_en.experiments: From the introduction, the evaluation focus is long-context serving, emphasizing robustness at extreme sparsity (e.g., 95%) with significant reductions in online decoding compute and KV transfer, aligned with the offline-prefill/online-decode reuse model (artifacts can be stored in CPU DRAM/SSD and fetched on demand). The full paper’s experiments are expected to report quality retention (e.g., perplexity/accuracy), speed/throughput gains vs sparsity, offline build cost and amortization, GPU utilization, and comparisons against token eviction, bandwidth-aware fetching (e.g., SparQ), and ANN/PQ/LSH-style retrieval baselines (to be confirmed in the experiments section).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical analysis + what to focus on)
1) Introduction: lock in the serving model (offline prefill vs online decode) and the argument that KV/bandwidth dominates; note Q/K distribution shift as the core failure mode at high sparsity.
2) Method: study (i) subspace partitioning (m) and centroid clustering (C), (ii) centroid-score precomputation and the compressed Top-L table layout, and (iii) the online accumulation + Top-k selection pipeline and why it maps to regular GPU kernels.
3) Incremental updates: understand how new keys update tables, the complexity dependence on m/C, and why overhead stays negligible.
4) Key figures: prioritize quality–sparsity–throughput curves and offline build cost vs amortization (break-even reuse).
5) Ablations: query-centric vs key-centric, necessity of subspace aggregation, Top-L capacity effects, and robustness under long-generation query drift.
Main contributions: (A) query-centric offline indexing for reusable prefill, (B) centroid-score + subspace accumulation for high-sparsity retrieval, (C) bounded Top-L tables with lightweight incremental maintenance, (D) GPU-friendly online execution without full-context scans.

skim (what to read)
- Read the Introduction for the scenario and why prior sparse/index methods degrade at high sparsity.
- Look at the method overview figure/pseudocode (two-phase: prefill build vs decode retrieval).
- Skim the main results at 90–95% sparsity (quality retention and throughput gains) and baseline comparisons.
- Check recommended m/C/L settings and sensitivity for practical adoption.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s message is that reusable long-context serving should push expensive work into the amortizable offline prefill stage, and that sustaining quality at extreme sparsity requires indexing aligned with query geometry rather than purely key-centric structures. CSAttention aims to unify high recall and high throughput without any training.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对“无训练稀疏注意力必掉点”的prior：把重计算前置到prefill并用centroid打分稳住高稀疏召回，建议立刻在你们长上下文服务复现吞吐/掉点曲线。
recommendation.en: Shifts my prior that training-free sparse attention must degrade: pushing heavy work to prefill and centroid scoring to keep recall at extreme sparsity—replicate on your long-context serving stack and plot throughput vs quality drop.

paper.title: Watt Counts: Energy-Aware Benchmark for Sustainable LLM Inference on Heterogeneous GPU Architectures

summary.core_problem: 缺少可复现、可对比的能耗评测与数据，导致LLM推理部署难以在异构GPU上做能效最优决策。
summary.importance: Benchmark/数据贡献：提供大规模开放能耗数据集与可扩展基准，直接服务LLM推理系统与可持续计算；对“硬件-模型-场景”能效权衡给出系统性证据。
summary.technical_approach: 发布Watt Counts：包含>5,000次实验、覆盖50个LLM、10种NVIDIA GPU，涵盖batch与server两类场景；提供可复现的开源benchmark并支持社区提交扩展；基于数据做系统层面对比分析，归纳不同模型/场景下GPU选择对能效的影响。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：50 LLM × 10 GPU × >5,000 runs；场景：batch与server；结论：最优GPU选择随模型与部署场景显著变化（摘要未给出具体指标提升幅度/统计细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM inference deployment lacks reproducible, comparable energy measurements, making it difficult to choose energy-optimal configurations across heterogeneous GPUs.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes an open benchmark and large-scale energy dataset that supports systematic, sustainable inference research and provides evidence for hardware–model–workload energy trade-offs in real deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Watt Counts, an open, reproducible benchmarking suite and dataset, and enables community extensions. Using the collected measurements, the authors analyze how energy efficiency varies with model choice, GPU type, and deployment scenario.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset includes >5,000 runs spanning 50 LLMs and 10 NVIDIA GPUs, evaluated in both batch and server scenarios. The main finding is that the energy-optimal GPU choice depends strongly on the model and serving setting; the abstract does not provide detailed effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 作为能耗数据与基准备查很够用，但对预训练研究增量有限；需要时只翻数据集覆盖范围、测量方法和几张能效对比图。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference benchmark/dataset for energy numbers, but little direct pretraining insight; skim the measurement methodology, coverage, and the key efficiency comparison figures.
